\chapter*{前\quad 言}
\markboth{前\quad 言}{前\quad 言}
\vspace{-0.6cm}
{\bodyfont
\hspace*{2em}这是一本给「赶时间」的人用的刷题手册：从力扣「热题 100」的 100 道题，到代码随想录题单里热题 100 之外的 128 道题，共 228 题，每题只保留最需要记的东西——一句话口诀、思路要点、复杂度、易错点，以及「先朴素、再优化」的两段 LeetCode 代码和一段 ACM 完整程序。\par
\par\hspace*{2em}与常见的题解书不同，本书不追求讲透每一道题的来龙去脉，而是按「面试验证」的方式组织：能不能在一分钟内说清思路，能不能在十分钟内写对代码。因此每道题都先给一句能背下来的口诀，再给 3 到 6 条能直接当答案说的要点，最后才给代码。\par
}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{13}{17}\selectfont 一、本书的结构}\par\vspace{4pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.2em,itemsep=5pt,topsep=2pt,label={\bfseries\arabic*.}]
\item {\bodyfont \textbf{一句话记忆}　每题都有一句口语化的口诀。考前只翻附录 A，四十分钟就能把 228 道题的思路过一遍——这是性价比最高的一轮复习。\par}
\item {\bodyfont \textbf{思路要点}　3 到 6 条，顺序就是面试口述的顺序：先一句核心思想，再两三句实现细节（状态定义、指针移动、转移方程），最后一句边界。\par}
\item {\bodyfont \textbf{朴素解法 / 优化解法}　先给最直白的写法（复杂度如实写清，慢但正确），再给能过题的优化写法；两段都是力扣签名，可直接提交，链表、二叉树的节点定义沿用官方写法。\par}
\item {\bodyfont \textbf{ACM 版}　笔试常考 ACM 模式：没有 Solution 类，要自己读标准输入、自己建链表和树、自己输出。每题都给了完整可运行的程序。\par}
\item {\bodyfont \textbf{题型模板}　每一章开头的一节说明这一类题在 ACM 模式下怎么读入、怎么输出，并给出模板程序，改两行就能用。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{10pt}\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{13}{17}\selectfont 二、七天速成计划}\par\vspace{5pt}
{\tablefont\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\leavevmode\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{1.9cm}>{\leavevmode\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{8.6cm}>{\leavevmode\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{4.4cm}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{天} & \textbf{内容} & \textbf{目标}\\ \midrule
\endhead
第 1 天 & 哈希、双指针、滑动窗口、子串、普通数组、矩阵（21 题） & 把数组上的几套固定套路打熟\\
第 2 天 & 链表（14 题） & 哨兵节点与快慢指针，手写不出错\\
第 3 天 & 二叉树（15 题） & 递归三部曲：参数、终止、单层逻辑\\
第 4 天 & 图论、回溯、二分查找（18 题） & 网格 DFS、回溯去重、二分边界\\
第 5 天 & 栈、堆、贪心（12 题） & 单调栈、堆取 TopK、区间贪心\\
第 6 天 & 动态规划、多维动态规划（15 题） & 背包五步法，滚动数组方向不能写反\\
第 7 天 & 技巧（5 题）＋ 附录 A 全过一遍 ＋ 补充篇错题 & 查漏补缺，稳定输出\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}}
\vspace{12pt}\indent{\bodyfont \textbf{三遍法}：第一遍只看题意和一句话记忆，能复述就过；第二遍合上书手写 LeetCode 版，写不出来再看代码；第三遍只看 ACM 版，专门练输入输出。三遍下来，228 题足以覆盖绝大多数笔试和一面。\par}
\indent{\bodyfont \textbf{关于补充篇}：热题 100 已经覆盖了高频考点，但代码随想录的题更偏体系——背包、单调栈、并查集、拓扑排序、最短路径这些在笔试里经常以变体出现，建议按专题顺序补。\par}

\chapter{哈希}
\begin{flushleft}
{\smallfont\color{grayt}I-1　3 题（简单 1，中等 2）\par}
\end{flushleft}
\vspace{2pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{12.5}{16}\selectfont 这一类输入怎么读}\par\vspace{3pt}
\indent{\bodyfont 哈希/集合类题目的输入几乎都是「一个 n，然后 n 个数（或 n 个字符串），最后一行目标值」。ACM 模式里不要用 input() 逐行读，统一 sys.stdin.read().split() 一次读成 token 列表，用游标往后取，这样换行、空格、多组数据的差异都被抹平了。\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\begin{vscode}{template.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{import}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}}
\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{3}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{main}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{data}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{stdin}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{read}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{split}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{7}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{8}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{;}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{;}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{10}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{target}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{;}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{13}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{print}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{twoSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\bodyfont\textbf{输出注意}　只打印最终答案，不要打印「please input」这类提示；列表输出用 print(*ans) 或 print(ans)，题目要求哪种格式就照哪种来。\par}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　1 两数之和，49 字母异位词分组，128 最长连续序列\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[两数之和]{两数之和（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给整数数组和目标值，找出和为目标值的两个数，返回它们的下标。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 9 $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 边扫边存，先查另一半再入表}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：把所有下标对 (i, j) 枚举一遍，i < j，相加等于 target 就返回，时间 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个数都要往后重扫一遍另一半，「找 target - x」是一次 O(n) 的线性查找，n 到 1e4 就会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把「另一半出现过没有」交给哈希表，遍历到 x 时先查 target - x 在不在表里。\par}
\item {\smallfont 查表 O(1)，整体时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)；先查后插，保证同一个元素不会被用两次。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}先查表再插入，否则 [3,3] 这类会把自己当答案；朴素版的双层循环也要让 j 从 i+1 开始，否则同一个元素会被用两次。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{twoSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[字母异位词分组]{字母异位词分组（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 49}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给字符串数组，把由相同字母重排得到的单词分到同一组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily strs = ["eat",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"tea",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"tan",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"ate",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"nat",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"bat"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [["bat"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["nat",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"tan"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["ate",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"eat",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"tea"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序后的单词当钥匙，同钥匙进同一格}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：两两比较，每拿到一个单词就把还没分组的单词都比一遍，是字母异位词就塞进同一组。\par}
\item {\smallfont 判断两个词是否异位词要排序比较，O(klogk)；外层再套一对一的 n$^{2}$ 次比较，时间 O(n$^{2}$·klogk)，单词一多就超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：给每个单词算一个「钥匙」——把字母排序成同一个字符串，异位词的钥匙必然相同。\par}
\item {\smallfont 用哈希表把钥匙映射到分组列表，每个单词只算一次钥匙、查一次表，时间降到 O(n·klogk)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 钥匙也可以换成 26 位计数数组，省掉排序的 log 因子。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·klogk)，空间 O(n·k)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不能只比长度或首字母；空串、单字符也要能正常成组；朴素版记得用 used 标记，否则同一个单词会被塞进好几个组。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{groupAnagrams}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{w}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{group}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{w}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{w}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{group}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{group}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[最长连续序列]{最长连续序列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 128}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给未排序整数数组，求数字连续的最长序列长度，要求 O(n)。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [100,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}200,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 只从起点往后数，起点是 x-1 不在集合}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：先把数丢进集合，再对每个数都往后数——y+1 在集合里就让 y 加一，最长的那一次就是答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个数都要一直数到它所在序列的末尾，[1,2,...,n] 这种会退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，数据量大时超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：只有 x-1 不在集合里时，x 才是一段连续序列的起点，从起点数到断为止就够了。\par}
\item {\smallfont 这样每个数最多被数两次，总时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)；空数组返回 0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}每个数都往后数会退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，必须只从序列起点数；朴素版对序列中段和重复元素会重复数很多遍。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{longestConsecutive}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{y}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\chapter{双指针}
\begin{flushleft}
{\smallfont\color{grayt}I-2　4 题（简单 1，中等 2，困难 1）\par}

\vspace{2pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{12.5}{16}\selectfont 这一类输入怎么读}\par\vspace{3pt}
\indent{\bodyfont 双指针题通常给「n + n 个数」，有的题（如三数之和）还要输出二维结果。把数组整体读进来即可，双指针本身在数组上跑，不需要额外输入。\par}

\vsline{4}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{data}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{stdin}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{read}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{split}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}

\vsline{8}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{map}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\bodyfont\textbf{输出注意}　二维答案统一「先输出行数，再每行输出一行」，机器判题一般都能过；如果题目只要求输出数量，就只打印 len。\par}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　283 移动零，11 盛最多水的容器，15 三数之和，42 接雨水\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[移动零]{移动零（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 283}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把数组里所有 0 移到末尾，非零元素保持原有顺序，要求原地。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}12]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}12,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 非零往前挪，剩下的位置补零}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：从前往后扫，遇到 0 就和后面的非零元素交换，让 0 一格一格「冒」到末尾。\par}
\item {\smallfont 一次交换只把 0 挪一格，最坏（一排 0 在前、非零在后）要换 O(n$^{2}$) 次，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，数据量大时超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：换个角度，不搬 0 而搬非零——写指针 w 指向下一个非零元素该放的位置，遇到非零就写到 nums[w]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 遍历完把 w 之后的位置一次补 0，非零的相对顺序天然不变，时间 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不能用额外数组或 pop/append，题目要求原地；全 0 也要正确；朴素交换版外层要跑够 n 轮，轮数不够会有 0 卡在中间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[盛最多水的容器]{盛最多水的容器（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 11}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给一排竖线的高度，选两条与 x 轴围成容器，求最大装水量。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily height = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 49\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右夹逼，每次挪矮的那根}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：枚举所有两条边的组合 (i, j)，面积 = min(h[i], h[j]) $\times$ (j - i)，取最大值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 组合有 n$^{2}$/2 对，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 1e5 时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：面积由「宽度」和「矮的那根」决定。左右指针从两端出发，每次只挪矮的一侧——挪高的一侧宽度变小、高度又不会增加，一定不会更优。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每移动一次就排除掉一根柱子，指针相遇即结束，时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}宽度是下标差而不是加一；两边等高时挪任意一侧都行；朴素版内层要从 i+1 开始，别把同一根柱子用两次。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxArea}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{area}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{area}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{area}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxArea}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[三数之和]{三数之和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 15}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}找出数组中所有和为 0 且互不重复的三元组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序固定第一个数，后两个用双指针夹}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：三重循环枚举 (i, j, k)，和为 0 就把三个数排好序塞进 set，靠 set 去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 三层循环是 O(n$^{3}$)，n = 3000 就基本跑不完，会超时（TLE）；set 还额外占空间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先排序，固定第一个数 nums[i]，后两个数用左右指针往中间夹：和小于 0 左指针右移，大于 0 右指针左移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两层循环把时间降到 O(n$^{2}$)；排序后相同元素挨在一起，跳过重复值即可天然去重，不再需要 set。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：nums[i] > 0 直接结束；i 和前一个位置相同则跳过。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(1)（不计结果）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}三处去重缺一不可：外层 i、左指针、右指针；朴素版则要保证 i<j<k，并用 set 存排序后的三元组，否则同一答案会重复。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{8}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{tuple}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[接雨水]{接雨水（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 42}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给柱子高度数组，求按这个排列能接住多少雨水。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily height = [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右指针谁矮先结算谁，减当前高度}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：对每个位置 i，往左扫出左边最高、往右扫出右边最高，这个位置的水量就是 min(左高, 右高) - h[i]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个位置都要左右各扫一遍，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 2e4 就会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：左右指针从两端往中间走，各自维护「这一侧见过的最高柱子」，哪边矮就先结算哪边。\par}
\item {\smallfont 矮的那侧水量只由该侧最高值决定，不用真的去另一边扫，一次遍历 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}先更新该侧最大值再算差值，否则矮柱处会算出负数；朴素版左右最大值都要包含 i 自己，漏掉最边上的柱子会多算水。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{trap}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{left\_max}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{right\_max}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{left\_max}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{right\_max}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}}
\end{vscode}

\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　3 无重复字符的最长子串，438 找到字符串中所有字母异位词\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[无重复字符的最长子串]{无重复字符的最长子串（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 3}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给字符串，求不含重复字符的最长连续子串的长度。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abcabcbb" $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 右指针进、左指针退，窗口内字符唯一}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：枚举所有子串 s[i:j+1]，用 set 判重，不重复就更新答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 子串有 O(n$^{2}$) 个，每个还要花 O(n) 建 set 判重，总时间 O(n$^{3}$)，长串直接超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：维护窗口 [left, right]，保证窗口内字符唯一；右指针每吞一个字符，就用哈希表记下它最后出现的位置。\par}
\item {\smallfont 新字符上次出现在窗口内时，left 直接跳到该位置 +1（不用一步步退），每步用窗口长度更新答案，时间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空串返回 0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(字符集)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}left 只能往右跳不能回退，要写 left = max(left, last+1)；朴素版判重要看 set(子串) 的长度，别只比较相邻两个字符。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{last}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{last}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{right}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}

\section[找到字符串中所有字母异位词]{找到字符串中所有字母异位词（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 438}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在 s 中找出所有 p 的字母异位词子串，返回起始下标。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "cbaebabacd",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} p = "abc" $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 定长窗口滑动，计数一致就记下标}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：先数出 p 的字符计数，再从每个位置 i 截出长度 k 的子串，重新数一遍字符，和 p 的计数相等就记下 i。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个窗口都从头数 k 个字符，共 n 个窗口，时间 O(n·k)；s 和 p 都很长时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：窗口定长滑动，右端进一个字符、左端出一个字符，每次只改动两个计数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 用长度 26 的计数数组做比较，窗口计数等于 p 的计数即命中，单次比较 O(1)，总时间 O(n + m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：i $\geq$ k 才需要删左边；窗口没凑满 k 个时不能记录。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n + m)，空间 O(1)（26 个桶）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}窗口还没凑满 len(p) 时不能记录，起点是 i-len(p)+1；朴素版上界要写 len(s)-k+1，末尾切片会自动变短，容易越界混算。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findAnagrams}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\bodyfont\textbf{输出注意}　输出单个数字时直接 print(int)；输出下标列表时按题目要求决定是否需要先输出长度。\par}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　560 和为 K 的子数组，239 滑动窗口最大值，76 最小覆盖子串\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[和为 K 的子数组]{和为 K 的子数组（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 560}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}统计数组中元素和为 k 的连续子数组个数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 2 $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 前缀和做差，哈希表数之前出现几次}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：枚举左端点 i，右端点 j 一路往右加，边加边判断这段和是不是 k，是就计数加一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 子数组有 O(n$^{2}$) 个，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 2e4 就会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：子数组和等于两个前缀和之差，pre[j] - pre[i] = k 等价于 pre[i] = pre[j] - k。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边遍历边把前缀和的出现次数存进哈希表，每步查 pre - k 出现过几次，就新增几个答案，时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 哈希表要先放 \{0: 1\}，否则从下标 0 开始的子数组会漏。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}初始前缀和 0 的计数必须为 1；元素为负不影响该做法；朴素版每换一个左端点 total 都要清零。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[滑动窗口最大值]{滑动窗口最大值（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 239}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给数组和窗口大小 k，返回每个滑动窗口中的最大值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 3 $\rightarrow$ [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 单调队列存下标，队头永远是最大值}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：每个窗口起点都截出 k 个数，直接调 max 求最大值，塞进结果。\par}
\item {\smallfont 相邻两个窗口有 k-1 个数是重复的，却每次都重新比较，时间 O(n·k)；k 接近 n 时退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用单调队列存下标，队列里的值从大到小递减；新元素入队前把队尾比它小（或相等）的都弹掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont 队头就是当前窗口最大值，下标滑出窗口（$\leq$ i-k）就从队头弹出；每个下标进出队列各一次，时间 O(n)、空间 O(k)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(k)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}队列里要存下标而不是值，否则判断不了是否滑出窗口；朴素版循环上界是 len(nums)-k+1，k 比数组长时不该进循环。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxSlidingWindow}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{head}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[最小覆盖子串]{最小覆盖子串（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 76}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在 s 中找包含 t 全部字符的最短子串，没有则返回空串。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "ADOBECODEBANC",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "ABC" $\rightarrow$ "BANC"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 右扩到覆盖，左缩到不覆盖，全程记最短}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：枚举所有子串，写个 cover 函数数一遍字符，看是否包含 t 的全部字符，能覆盖就更新最短答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 子串有 O(n$^{2}$) 个，每次覆盖检查 O(n)，总时间 O(n$^{3}$)，字符串长一点就超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成滑动窗口——右指针扩张到刚好覆盖 t，再让左指针尽量收缩，收缩全程记录最短。\par}
\item {\smallfont 用 need/win 两个计数表加一个「达标字符种类数」，窗口是否覆盖只需 O(1) 判断，总时间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：无解返回空串；t 里有重复字符时按次数算，不是按种类算。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(字符集)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}用「种类数达标」判断覆盖，别逐字符比较；无解输出空串；朴素版 cover 必须按次数比，t = "aa" 时只判字符出现过就会错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minWindow}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{need}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\{}\textcolor{vstext}{\}}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{need}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{need}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{get}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{6}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{need}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{items}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{get}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}

\vsline{15}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{19}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{20}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{cover}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{21}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　53 最大子数组和，56 合并区间，189 轮转数组，238 除自身以外数组的乘积，41 缺失的第一个正数\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[最大子数组和]{最大子数组和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 53}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求数组中和最大的连续子数组的和，子数组至少含一个元素。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 前缀和变负就丢掉，从当前数重新开始}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：枚举所有子数组 [i, j]，边加边和当前最优比较，取最大的和。\par}
\item {\smallfont 子数组有 O(n$^{2}$) 个，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 1e5 时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：只关心「以当前元素结尾的最大和」cur，转移 cur = max(x, cur + x)——前面那段和为负就丢掉，从 x 重新开始。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每步用 cur 更新全局 best，一遍扫描时间 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont best 初始化成 nums[0]，全负数时答案就是最大的那个负数。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}best 不能初始化成 0，否则全负数数组会返回错误结果；朴素版换一个左端点就要把 total 清零。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxSubArray}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxSubArray}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\section[合并区间]{合并区间（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 56}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}合并所有重叠区间，返回互不重叠且覆盖原区间的结果。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily intervals = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}10]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}18]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}10]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}18]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 按左端点排序，能接上就延长右端点}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：不排序，把区间一个个塞进结果，遇到重叠的就并成一个，并完再和别的区间继续比。\par}
\item {\smallfont 并一次可能又撞上别的区间，所以要反复扫到「一遍下来没有合并」为止，最坏 O(n$^{3}$)，数据量大时超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先按左端点排序，能合并的区间就一定是相邻的。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序后只要一趟：新区间左端点 $\leq$ 结果里最后一个区间的右端点就合并（右端点取 max），否则直接追加，总时间 O(nlogn)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(nlogn)，空间 O(n)（不计排序栈）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}重叠判断用 $\leq$ 而不是 <；合并时右端点必须取 max；朴素版要扫到没有变化为止，只并一遍会漏掉传递重叠。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{merge}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{intervals}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{intervals}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{out}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{out}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{iv}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{15}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{16}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{17}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{18}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{out}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{19}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{out}}
\vsline{20}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[轮转数组]{轮转数组（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 189}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把数组元素向右轮转 k 位，要求原地修改。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 3 $\rightarrow$ [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 整体翻转，再翻前 k 段和后 n-k 段}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：真的按题意「把整个数组右移一位」，重复 k 次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每轮都要搬 n 个元素，k 又可能接近 n，时间 O(n·k)；n = 1e5、k = 5e4 时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：看出右移 k 位 = 整体翻转 + 前 k 段翻转 + 后 n-k 段翻转。\par}
\item {\smallfont 三次翻转都在原数组上做，时间 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：先 k \%= n，k 可能大于数组长度。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}忘记 k \%= n 会在 k > n 时出错；k 为 0 时别翻空区间；朴素版要先把最后一位存起来，否则会被前一位覆盖。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\%}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\end{vscode}

\section[除自身以外数组的乘积]{除自身以外数组的乘积（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 238}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}返回数组，每个位置是除自身外其余元素的乘积，不许用除法。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [24,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}12,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先存左边积，再从右乘上右边积}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：对每个位置 i，把除 nums[i] 以外的数全部乘一遍。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两层循环，时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 1e5 时会超时（TLE）；虽然绕开了除法，但还是太慢。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：答案 = i 左侧所有数的积 $\times$ i 右侧所有数的积。\par}
\item {\smallfont 从左往右扫一遍把左侧积存进 ans[i]；再从右往左扫一遍，用变量 suf 累乘右侧积，边乘边更新 suf。\par}
\item {\smallfont 结果数组之外只多一个变量，时间 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)（不计输出数组）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}有 0 时除法会失效，题目也禁止除法，前后缀积天然正确；朴素版判断 j != i 时别把自身乘进去。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[缺失的第一个正数]{缺失的第一个正数（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 41}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}找出数组中缺失的最小正整数，要求 O(n) 时间和常数空间。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 值 x 换到下标 x-1，再找第一个错位}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：从 1 开始往上试，x 在数组里就让 x 加一，第一个不在数组里的就是答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每次「在不在」都是对数组做一次 O(n) 的线性查找，答案最多是 n+1，总时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n = 1e5 会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：答案一定在 1..n+1 之间，只关心落在 [1, n] 的数——把值为 x 的数换到下标 x-1，让数组自己变成哈希表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 再扫一遍，第一个 nums[i] != i+1 的位置答案就是 i+1；全部归位则答案是 n+1，时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}交换可能死循环，必须判断 nums[nums[i]-1] != nums[i] 防重复；朴素版的 in list 是 O(n) 查找，别当成 O(1)。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{firstMissingPositive}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}}
\end{vscode}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[矩阵置零]{矩阵置零（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 73}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}矩阵中为 0 的元素所在行和列全部置 0，要求原地完成。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily matrix = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 第一行第一列当标记板，最后再补自己}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：另开 rows、cols 两个标记数组，先扫一遍记下哪些行、哪些列含 0，再扫一遍按标记置零。\par}
\item {\smallfont 写法对，但要多花 O(m+n) 的额外空间；如果偷懒边扫边原地置零，新写下的 0 会被当成原来的 0，越清越多。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：直接把矩阵的第一行、第一列当标记板——遇到 matrix[i][j] == 0 就写 matrix[i][0] = matrix[0][j] = 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 再按标记清零非首行首列，最后用两个布尔量补处理第一行、第一列自己，额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 顺序不能反：先标记、再清零、最后处理第一行和第一列。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}顺序不能反：先标记、再清零、最后处理第一行和第一列；朴素版若改成一边扫描一边原地置零，会把新写的 0 当原 0 传染全图。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
