\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{setZeroes}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cols}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cols}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cols}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\end{vscode}

\section[螺旋矩阵]{螺旋矩阵（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 54}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按顺时针螺旋顺序返回矩阵中的所有元素。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily matrix = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 四边界收缩，走完一行一列就收一格}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：模拟走路——从 (0,0) 往右走，撞到边界或走过的格子就右转，一共走 m*n 步。\par}
\item {\smallfont 要另开一个 visited 数组记住哪些格子走过，空间 O(mn)；转弯条件写错还容易死循环。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不要 visited，用 top、bottom、left、right 四个边界框住还没走的区域，每走完一条边就收缩一格。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界交叉就结束，额外空间只有四个变量，时间 O(mn)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 只剩一行或一列时要判 top $\leq$ bottom、left $\leq$ right 防重复输出。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(1)（不计结果）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}单行或单列时若不加边界判断，会重复输出同一批元素；朴素版转弯要同时检查越界和已访问，漏一个就会死循环或重复。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[旋转图像]{旋转图像（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 48}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把 n$\times$n 矩阵原地顺时针旋转 90 度。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily matrix = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先沿主对角线转置，再左右翻转每行}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：按旋转规则直接算新位置——原 (i, j) 会到 (j, n-1-i)，开一个新矩阵接住，最后再拷回去。\par}
\item {\smallfont 答案是对的，但要多开一个 n$\times$n 的矩阵，空间 O(n$^{2}$)；题目要求原地修改。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：顺时针 90 度 = 先沿主对角线转置，再把每行左右翻转。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转置只交换 i < j 的对称元素，翻转用首尾双指针，两步都在原矩阵上完成，时间 O(n$^{2}$)、额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：n = 1 时两段循环都不执行，直接结束。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}转置内层循环要从 i+1 开始，从 0 开始会把已换的又换回去；朴素版坐标别写反：(i, j) $\rightarrow$ (j, n-1-i) 才是顺时针。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\section[搜索二维矩阵 II]{搜索二维矩阵 II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 240}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在每行升序、每列升序的 m$\times$n 矩阵里查 target，返回是否存在。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily matrix = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}12,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}19]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}16,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}22]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}13,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}14,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}17,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}24]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[18,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}21,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}23,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}26,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}30]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 5 $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 右上角起步：比它大往左，比它小往下}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：两重 for 把整个矩阵扫一遍，碰到 target 就返回 true，扫完没有就 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个格子都要看一次，时间 O(m*n)；m=n=1e3 时就是上百万次比较，数据量大时会超时（TLE），而且完全没用上「行、列都升序」这个条件。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：从右上角出发 —— 这个位置的左边都更小、下边都更大，当前值比 target 大就左移一列，比它小就下移一行。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每步砍掉一整行或一整列，最多走 m+n 步，时间 O(m+n)，额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 注意别从左上角出发，那里两个方向都变大，无法决定往哪走；矩阵为空时直接返回 false。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}朴素两重循环没用上「行、列都升序」，O(m*n) 在大矩阵上会 TLE；优化版别从左上角出发，那里两个方向都变大，无法决定往哪走。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchMatrix}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　160 相交链表，206 反转链表，234 回文链表，141 环形链表，142 环形链表 II，21 合并两个有序链表，2 两数相加，19 删除链表的倒数第 N 个结点，24 两两交换链表中的节点，25 K 个一组翻转链表，138 随机链表的复制，148 排序链表，23 合并 K 个升序链表，146 LRU 缓存\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[相交链表]{相交链表（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 160}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给两条单链表的头节点，返回它们相交的第一个节点，无交点返回空。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily intersectVal = 8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} listA = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} listB = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 8\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 走到头就换对方链表，a+c+b 必相遇}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：对 A 的每个节点，都把 B 从头到尾扫一遍，看有没有「同一个节点」。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两层循环，时间 O(m*n)；两条各 1e5 的链相乘就是 1e10 次，数据量大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两个指针分别从 A、B 出发，走到 null 就换到另一条链的头，双方都恰好走 a+c+b 步，有交点时必同时落在交点上。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 比较必须用 is 判节点身份，不能用 val；无交点时两指针会同时变成 null，循环自然结束。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}必须比较节点引用 is 而非 val，值相同不代表同一节点；朴素两层循环能查到但 O(m*n)，大数据会 TLE。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[反转链表]{反转链表（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 206}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给单链表头节点，把链表反转后返回新的头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先存后继再掉头，prev 就是新头}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先把整条链的值抄进数组，再从数组尾部往头读，逐个新建节点串成新链表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但要额外 O(n) 的数组，还把每个节点都重新 new 了一遍 —— 原来的节点全被丢掉，空间翻倍。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：三指针原地掉头 —— 先存好后继，把 cur.next 改指 prev，然后 prev、cur 各自前移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)，一个节点都不用新建。\par}
\item {\smallfont 改指针前必须先保存 next，否则断链；空链表直接返回 None，最后返回的是 prev 而不是原来的 head。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}朴素版借数组 + 新建节点，空间 O(n)；三指针版忘记先保存 next 会断链，最后返回 prev 而不是原来的 head。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{reverseList}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ListNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ListNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[回文链表]{回文链表（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 234}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给单链表头节点，判断它是否左右对称（回文），返回布尔值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 快慢找中点，反转后半段，两头对撞}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把链表的值全部拷进数组，再用首尾两个下标往中间对撞，逐对比值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 数组比较本身是 O(n)，但额外占了 O(n) 空间；题目进阶要求 O(1) 空间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：快慢指针找到中点，把后半段原地反转，再让头指针和反转后的尾指针同步前移逐个比。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)；奇数长度时中间那个节点自然被跳过。\par}
\item {\smallfont 反转会改动链表结构，题目要求原样时需再反转恢复。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}朴素数组法要多 O(n) 空间；快慢指针版反转会改动链表结构，题目要求原样时需再反转恢复。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\end{vscode}

\section[环形链表]{环形链表（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 141}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给单链表头节点，判断链表中是否存在环，返回布尔值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} pos = 1 $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 快慢指针跑圈，追上就是有环}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：一边遍历一边把走过的节点记进集合，第二次走到同一个节点就说明有环。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但要额外 O(n) 的集合；题目进阶要 O(1) 空间，长链表上内存吃不消。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：快慢指针，slow 每次一步、fast 每次两步，有环时 fast 每轮把距离缩小一步，一定追上 slow。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 循环条件写 fast and fast.next，避免对 None 取 next；单节点自环也算有环。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}循环条件漏掉 fast.next 会空指针；朴素集合法额外 O(n) 空间，单节点自环也算有环。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{hasCycle}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ListNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{fast}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{fast}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{slow}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{is}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{fast}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[环形链表 II]{环形链表 II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 142}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给单链表头节点，返回环的入口节点，无环返回空。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} pos = 1 $\rightarrow$ 返回索引为 1 的节点\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 相遇后一个回起点，同速再走就是入口}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：顺序遍历并把节点记进集合，第一个「第二次出现」的节点就是环的入口。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但要存 O(n) 个节点，额外空间 O(n)；而且只是判了位置，没解释为什么是入口。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：快慢指针先确认有环；设头到入口长 a、入口到相遇点长 b、相遇点到入口长 c，相遇时两者步数差是环长的整数倍，可推出「从 head 和从相遇点同速走会在入口相遇」。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)，全程不改链表结构。\par}
\item {\smallfont 相遇点不是入口；重新出发后两个指针都要每次走一步。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}相遇点不是入口，重新出发后两指针都要每次一步；朴素集合法要多 O(n) 空间，且答不出「为什么是入口」。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}}

\section[合并两个有序链表]{合并两个有序链表（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 21}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把两个升序链表合并成一个升序链表，返回新链表头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily l1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} l2 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 哑节点起手，谁小接谁，剩的整段挂上}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把两条链的值全收进数组，排序，再按顺序新建节点串成一条链表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序要 O((m+n) log(m+n))，还要 O(m+n) 的数组并新建全部节点；而两条链本来就有序，这次排序完全是白做的。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：哑节点 + 双指针，谁小接谁，边走边合并，结果天然有序。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)，直接复用原来的节点。\par}
\item {\smallfont 一条走空后把另一条剩下的整段挂到 cur.next 即可；返回 dummy.next 而不是 dummy 本身。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}忘记接剩余段会丢节点；返回 dummy 而不是 dummy.next；朴素数组法额外 O(m+n) 空间还多做了一次排序。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[两数相加]{两数相加（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 2}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}两个非负整数按逆序存在链表里，逐位相加，返回同形式的和链表。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily l1 = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} l2 = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 逆序正好从低位加起，进位别忘了补位}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先把两条链表还原成整数，相加，再把结果的每一位拆出来建新链表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 要先扫两遍拼出完整整数，位数一多，字符串拼接和大整数运算的代价都上来了，C++/Java 里还会直接溢出 —— 本质是「先算出整体再拆开」。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：链表本来就是逆序存的，顺着走正好从低位加起，逐位相加 + 进位即可，不必还原成整数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(max(m,n))，空间 O(1)（不算返回的链表）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 循环条件要带上 carry，两条链走完还有进位时要再补一个节点；缺位按 0 补。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(max(m,n))，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}循环只写 l1 or l2 会丢掉最高位的进位 1；朴素「先还原成整数」在大数上会溢出（C++/Java）且更慢。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[删除链表的倒数第 N 个结点]{删除链表的倒数第 N 个结点（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 19}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给链表头节点和 n，删掉倒数第 n 个节点，返回新的头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} n = 2 $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 快指针先跑 n 步，慢指针再陪到末尾}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把所有节点按顺序装进数组，要删的就是数组里的倒数第 n 个，删掉后再重新串一遍。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(L)，但要额外 O(L) 的数组，链表本来省空间的优势就没了；而且「重新串」还得处理末尾的 next。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：加 dummy 后让 fast 先走 n 步，再和 slow 同步前移；fast 走到最后一个节点时，slow 正好停在待删节点的前驱。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(L)，空间 O(1)，一趟就能删掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont n 等于链表长度时删的是原来的头，dummy 正好兜住这种情况。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(L)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不加 dummy 又要删头节点会出错；slow 要停在待删节点的前驱；朴素数组法额外 O(L) 空间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[两两交换链表中的节点]{两两交换链表中的节点（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 24}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把链表中相邻的两个节点两两交换，只能改指针，返回新头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每次把第二个节点提到前面来}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把节点按顺序装进数组，数组里相邻两个交换位置，再重新串成链表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但要额外 O(n) 的数组；题目明确要求只能改指针，数组法绕开了这件事。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：dummy 起手，prev 指向当前这对节点的前一个，取 a = prev.next、b = a.next 后三步改指针：a.next = b.next、b.next = a、prev.next = b。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)；剩单个节点时不动。\par}
\item {\smallfont 交换完 prev 移到 a，也就是这一对里靠后的那个，再去下一对；改指针顺序错会断链或成环。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}改指针顺序错会断链或成环；是交换节点而不是交换 val；朴素数组法额外 O(n) 空间，绕开了「只改指针」的要求。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{swapPairs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ListNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ListNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nodes}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{head}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nodes}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[K 个一组翻转链表]{K 个一组翻转链表（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 25}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每 k 个节点一组翻转链表，不足 k 个的尾部保持原序，返回新头。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 2 $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先数够 k 个再翻，翻完前后接好}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把节点全部装进数组，每 k 个一组在数组里倒序，不足 k 个的原样留下，再重新串起来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但要额外 O(n) 的数组，而且「不足 k 个不翻」这个边界在数组下标里很容易写错。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：原地分组 —— 先往后数 k 步确认够不够，记下组内最后一个 kth 和下一组的头 nxt，把组内反转到 nxt 为止，再把前后接好。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不足 k 个直接返回；反转的初始 prev 要设成下一组的头 nxt，而不是 None。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不足 k 个不能翻转；反转初值要设成下一组的头而不是 None；朴素数组法额外 O(n) 空间，边界（不足 k 个）容易写错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{17}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}

\section[随机链表的复制]{随机链表的复制（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 138}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}复制一条带 random 指针的链表，返回全新节点组成的深拷贝。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[13,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[13,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 克隆节点插在原节点身后，random 跟着走}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先不管 random，用哈希表记下「原节点 $\rightarrow$ 新节点」，第一遍只顺着 next 把所有克隆节点建出来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 第二遍再补指针：新节点的 next / random 直接从哈希表里查原节点对应的克隆；时间 O(n)，但要多 O(n) 的哈希表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 题目进阶要求 O(1) 额外空间，哈希表就是那个要省掉的东西。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把克隆节点直接插在原节点身后（A$\rightarrow$A'$\rightarrow$B$\rightarrow$B'），这样 cur.random.next 恰好就是克隆节点的 random，哈希表整个不需要了。\par}
\item {\smallfont 最后拆成两条链并把原链表的 next 还原；random 为空时要判空，random 指向自己也能被这套写法覆盖。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)（不计返回值）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}取 cur.random.next 前要判空；拆链时原链表必须保持完整；朴素哈希法要多 O(n) 空间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给链表头节点，把节点按值升序排列后返回排序后的头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 找中点劈两半，递归归并再合并}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把值全部收进数组，用 sort() 排好，再按顺序写回原来的节点。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n log n)，但要额外 O(n) 数组，而且只改了 val、没动节点，面试通常要求排的是节点本身。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：链表归并 —— 快慢指针找中点把链表断成两段，递归排好左右，再合并两条有序链。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(log n)（递归栈）；要求 O(1) 空间时可改成自底向上，按步长 1、2、4 两两合并。\par}
\item {\smallfont 找到中点后必须断开，否则递归不收敛、栈溢出。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(log n)（递归栈）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}找到中点后必须断开，否则递归不收敛、栈溢出；朴素数组法额外 O(n) 空间且只改 val 不排节点。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[合并 K 个升序链表]{合并 K 个升序链表（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 23}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给 k 条升序链表的头节点数组，合并成一条升序链表并返回头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily lists = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两两归并成倍扩，别逐个往里插}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把 k 条链的值全部倒进一个数组，排序，再新建一条链表装回去。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(N log N)（N 是总节点数），额外 O(N) 空间，而且完全没利用「每条链本身已经有序」。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两两归并 —— 第 i 条与第 i+step 条合并，step 从 1 开始倍增，每轮链表数减半，共 log k 轮。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每轮总节点数都是 N，所以总时间 O(N log k)，直接复用节点、空间 O(1)，优于逐条合并的 O(Nk)。\par}
\item {\smallfont k 为 0 返回空，注意空链表；也可用小顶堆维护各链当前头，适合数据流式到达的场景。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log k)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}逐条往结果里合并会退化成 O(Nk)；注意 k=0 和空链表；朴素全排序法额外 O(N) 空间，浪费了各链已有的有序性。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{node}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{next}}

\section[LRU 缓存]{LRU 缓存（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 146}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}实现 LRU 缓存：按容量淘汰最久未使用的键，get 与 put 均要 O(1)。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily capacity = 2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} put(1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} put(2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} get(1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} put(3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} get(2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} -1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 哈希定位加双向链表排队，头新尾旧}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：只用一个哈希表存 key $\rightarrow$ [value, 最近使用的时间戳]，get 命中就把时间戳刷新成当前时刻。\par}
\item {\smallfont get 本身是 O(1)，但 put 一旦要淘汰，就得把整张表扫一遍找时间戳最小的键，最坏 O(capacity)，达不到题目要求的 get/put 都 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：哈希表负责 O(1) 定位，双向链表负责排队 —— 头部最新、尾部最旧，get 命中或 put 更新就把节点摘下来插到头部。\par}
\item {\smallfont get/put 均摊 O(1)，空间 O(capacity)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 加 head/tail 哨兵可以省掉大量判空；淘汰时链表节点和哈希表项必须一起删。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 get/put 均 O(1)，空间 O(capacity)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}淘汰时链表节点和哈希表项要一起删，漏一个就出错；朴素「扫全表找最久未用」是 O(capacity)，不满足 O(1)。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[二叉树的中序遍历]{二叉树的中序遍历（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 94}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给二叉树根节点，按中序（左-根-右）返回所有节点值的列表。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左到底再弹栈取值，然后转右子树}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：照着定义写递归 —— 先走完左子树，再记当前节点的值，最后走右子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，但递归深度等于树高 h；链状树（h 接近 1e4）在 Python 里会直接 RecursionError。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用显式栈模拟递归 —— 从 cur 出发一路把左孩子压栈直到 null，弹出栈顶记值，再转向它的右子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)，但栈开在堆上，不受递归深度限制。\par}
\item {\smallfont 循环条件是 cur or stack，缺一不可；空树返回空列表。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}递归版在链状树上会爆栈（Python 默认递归深度约 1000）；迭代版循环条件只写 cur 会漏掉右子树。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{inorderTraversal}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{stack}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}}

\section[二叉树的最大深度]{二叉树的最大深度（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 104}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给二叉树根节点，返回从根到最远叶子路径上的节点个数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 树高等于左右子树高的较大者加一}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：直接按定义递归 —— 空节点深度为 0，非空节点返回 max(左子树深, 右子树深) + 1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个节点只会被访问一次，时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)（递归栈），这已经是最优，本题没有更聪明的做法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不想用递归栈时可以写成层序遍历，每弹完一层深度加一，空间 O(最宽一层)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 深度按节点数算：根节点算一层，所以是 +1 而不是 +0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空树返回 0 而不是 1；单节点返回 1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}空树返回 0 而不是 1；深度数节点，不是数边。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[翻转二叉树]{翻转二叉树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 226}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给二叉树根节点，把每个节点的左右子树互换，返回翻转后的根。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每个节点都换左右孩子，递归到底}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：直接递归 —— 对每个节点把 left 和 right 交换，再递归处理两个孩子。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个节点恰好交换一次，时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)（递归栈），这已经是最优，本题没有更聪明的做法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不想用递归时，可以层序遍历：弹出节点就交换它的两个孩子并入队，思路完全等价。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空节点直接返回，作为递归出口。\par}
\item {\smallfont 只交换根节点的孩子不够，每棵子树的内部也要换。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只交换根节点的孩子不够，每棵子树的内部也要换；返回值是翻转后的根。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{invertTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{invertTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{invertTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}}
\end{vscode}

\section[对称二叉树]{对称二叉树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 101}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给二叉树根节点，判断它是否左右镜像对称，返回布尔值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左的左配右的右，左的右配右的左}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：写辅助函数 same(a, b) 按镜像递归比较 —— 两个都空返回 true，只有一个空返回 false，否则值相等且 same(a.left, b.right)、same(a.right, b.left) 都成立。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个节点只访问一次，时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)（递归栈），这已经是最优，本题没有更聪明的做法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不想用递归时，把节点成对放进队列迭代，遇到不匹配直接返回 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 关键是「镜像」：比较的不是左右子树是否相同，而是左的左配右的右、左的右配右的左。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空树、单节点都算对称。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}写成 same(a.left, b.left) 就变成判断两棵子树是否相同；只有一个为空时必须返回 false。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}

\section[二叉树的直径]{二叉树的直径（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 543}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给二叉树根节点，返回任意两节点间最长路径的边数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右子树高度之和，边走边更新最大}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先写一个求高度的 height()，然后对每个节点都算一次「左高 + 右高」，再递归到左右子树取最大。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在高度被反复重算 —— 每个节点都被它的每一层祖先各算一次，链状树上退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，n=1e4 时就会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：只做一次后序遍历，depth(node) 返回以它为端点向下走的节点数，回来时顺手用「左高 + 右高」更新全局最大值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)（递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 最长路径可能不经过根，所以更新要在每个节点做，不能只在根算一次；高度按节点数、直径按边数，正好差一。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只在根节点算一次会漏掉藏在子树里的更长路径；朴素「每个节点都重算高度」是 O(n$^{2}$)，链状树会 TLE。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{diameterOfBinaryTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\section[二叉树的层序遍历]{二叉树的层序遍历（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 102}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给一棵二叉树，按层从左到右返回每层节点值组成的二维列表。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 队列记层宽，一层一清零}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：先递归求出树高 h，再对第 0 层到第 h-1 层各做一次整树遍历，把这一层的值收集起来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每一层都要从根重新走一遍整棵树，同一个节点被反复访问；树退化成链时 h=n，总代价变成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：换队列做 BFS，每轮先记下本层节点数，弹完这一层才进下一层，每个节点只进出队一次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)（队列里最多一层节点）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 入队前先判空，不要往队列里塞 None，能少一半无用操作。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}循环次数要先用 size 固定，别边弹边用变化的队列长度。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[将有序数组转换为二叉搜索树]{将有序数组转换为二叉搜索树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 108}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给一个升序数组，构造一棵高度平衡的二叉搜索树并返回根节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [-10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每次取中点当根，左右递归分半}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每次递归都先把当前这一段扫一遍数出长度，取偏左中点做根，再切片出左右两段各自递归。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在两处重复劳动：数长度要扫一遍，切片 arr[:m] / arr[m+1:] 又要把元素整段复制一遍，每一层都做一次，总代价 O(n log n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把「这一段」换成 nums 上的左右下标 l、r，中点直接 (l+r)//2，不再复制任何数组。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)（每个元素只被建成一个节点），空间 O(log n) 递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两种写法都取偏左中点，建出来的树完全一样；差别只在有没有反复数长度、反复复制。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(log n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}别用切片复制子数组，改用左右下标原地划分，省空间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[验证二叉搜索树]{验证二叉搜索树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 98}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断给定二叉树是否为有效的二叉搜索树。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 带上开区间上下界往下传}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：BST 的中序遍历一定严格递增，所以先把所有值按中序存进数组，再从头查一遍相邻两项。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在要额外 O(n) 的数组：节点有多少就得存多少，而且必须等整棵树走完才能判断。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不存数组，递归时把「允许的取值区间」往下传，当前值必须严格落在开区间 (low, high) 里。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)（只占递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 进左子树把 high 收紧为当前值，进右子树把 low 收紧为当前值；等于边界也不合法，初值用 $\pm$inf。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}写中序解法时要用 pre 记录前驱，不能只和父节点比。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[二叉搜索树中第 K 小的元素]{二叉搜索树中第 K 小的元素（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 230}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在二叉搜索树中找出第 k 小的节点值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 1 $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 中序遍历，数到 k 就停}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：BST 中序遍历得到升序数组，第 k 小就是 vals[k-1]，那就先把整棵树走完存下来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在明明只要第 1 小，也要把 n 个节点全部访问、全部存下：时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用栈做迭代中序，每弹出一个节点就把 k 减一，减到 0 立刻返回，它后面的节点根本不用碰。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(h+k)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont k 从 1 开始计数，所以弹出后先减一，再判断是否为零。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(h+k)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}朴素版存完整中序数组再取下标可以过，但白花 O(n) 空间；改成迭代中序时注意 k 从 1 开始，弹出后先减一再判零。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[二叉树的右视图]{二叉树的右视图（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 199}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}站在二叉树右侧，按从上到下的顺序返回每层最右边的节点值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 层序遍历，每层最后一个就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：右视图就是每层最右边的节点。先求树高，再对每一层从根扫一遍全树，取该层最后一个值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在为了拿每层一个数，整棵树被重复扫了 h 遍，链状树退化成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：层序遍历一次解决，每层弹出最后一个节点时记下答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空树返回空列表；也可以先右后左入队，那样每层第一个就是答案。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不能只沿 right 指针走，左子树的节点也可能露在右侧。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{rightSideView}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\section[二叉树展开为链表]{二叉树展开为链表（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 114}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把二叉树原地展开成按先序遍历顺序排列的单链表，只用 right 指针。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左子树搬到右边，原右树接最右端}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：递归展平左右子树，再把整条左链搬到右边，然后顺着新右链走到尾巴接上原来的右子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个节点都要再沿左子树的右链走一遍找尾巴，这段路被上层反复重走；左偏的树退化成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：换个遍历顺序——按「右、左、根」的逆先序递归，每个节点处理时它的后继已经处理好了，直接 node.right = prev 串起来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)（每个节点只处理一次），空间 O(h) 递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 先递归右边再递归左边；每次要把 node.left 置空，prev 记刚刚串好的那条链的头。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}朴素版接原右子树前必须先保存它，否则链会在中途断掉；逆先序版则别忘 node.left = None。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[从前序与中序遍历序列构造二叉树]{从前序与中序遍历序列构造二叉树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 105}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定先序和中序遍历序列，重建这棵二叉树并返回根节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily preorder = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} inorder = [9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先序定根，中序切左右}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：先序第一个是根，那就每次在当前中序区间里从头线性找根的位置，切出左右两段再递归。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在找根是 O(区间长度)，退化成单链时每层只少一个元素，总代价 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先建一张「值 -> 中序下标」的哈希表，找根变成 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)（哈希表 + 递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 右子树的先序起点是 pl + 左子树长度 + 1，别写成 pl + 左子树长度。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}先序中右子树的起点是根下标加一再加左子树长度，别写错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[路径总和 III]{路径总和 III（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 437}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}统计二叉树中节点值之和等于 targetSum 的向下路径条数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} targetSum = 8 $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 前缀和配哈希，回头查 curr-target}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：把每个节点都当成路径起点，向下 DFS 枚举所有「从这个点往下」的路径，和等于 target 就记一条。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在同一个节点会被上层起点反复算进路径里，链状树上退化成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：路径和等于两个前缀和之差，于是 DFS 时只累加一个 curr，用哈希表数「curr - target 出现过几次」。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 哈希表初始放 \{0: 1\}（表示从根开始的空路径），回溯时记得把 curr 的计数减一。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}忘记回溯减计数，不同分支的前缀和会互相污染。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[二叉树的最近公共祖先]{二叉树的最近公共祖先（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 236}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求二叉树中两个指定节点的最近公共祖先。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} p = 5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} q = 1 $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右各找，都找到就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：分别求出根到 p、根到 q 的两条路径，再从头比较，最后一个相同的节点就是最近公共祖先。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在要存两条 O(n) 的路径，而且整棵树被走了两遍。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：一次后序递归——空节点或命中 p/q 就返回当前节点，左右子树都非空说明 p、q 各在一边，当前节点即答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont p、q 自己也可能是祖先，命中就直接返回，不要继续往下钻。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}p、q 自身可以是祖先，命中后直接返回，不要继续往下钻。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[二叉树中的最大路径和]{二叉树中的最大路径和（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 124}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求二叉树中任意一条路径的最大节点和，路径至少包含一个节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [-10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 42\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 单边贡献给父亲，拐弯处更新全局}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：把每个节点都当成路径的「最高点」，左右各跑一次 down 求最佳下行链，再取最大值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 down 会把整棵子树走一遍，而 walk 又对每个节点都调一次，链状树退化成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：后序遍历只跑一次——gain 返回以当前节点为端点往下走的最大单边和，顺手在「拐弯处」更新全局答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 单边和取 node.val + max(左, 右, 0)，拐弯和取 node.val + 左 + 右；答案可能为负，best 初值给负无穷。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}返回给父节点时只能带一边，不能把左右同时算进去。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{从}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{node}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{往下走一条链，最多能拿到多少和}}

\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\vsline{16}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cand}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{17}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cand}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{18}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cand}}
\vsline{19}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{walk}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{20}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{walk}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
