\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxPathSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{float}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"-inf"}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\bodyfont\textbf{输出注意}　网格类题目（岛屿数量等）把每行读成字符串再转 list；拓扑排序记得输出「入度为 0 的节点顺序」，无解输出空或题目要求的值。\par}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　200 岛屿数量，994 腐烂的橘子，207 课程表，208 实现 Trie（前缀树）\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[岛屿数量]{岛屿数量（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 200}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在只含 0 和 1 的网格中，统计上下左右相连的陆地岛屿数量。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily grid = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 遇 1 计数，再把整座岛淹掉}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：先让每块陆地各占一个编号，然后反复整表扫描，把相邻陆地改成同一个编号，直到一轮下来没有任何变化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在编号一次只能往相邻传一格，最坏要传 O(mn) 轮，每轮都扫全表，总代价 O((mn)$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：根本不用等它慢慢收敛——扫到 1 就把岛屿数加一，并从这一格 DFS/BFS 把整座岛一次淹成 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)（DFS 递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 进入 DFS 时要立刻标记，否则同一座岛会被重复计数。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}进入 DFS 时要立刻标记，否则同一座岛会被重复计数。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[腐烂的橘子]{腐烂的橘子（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 994}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每分钟腐烂橘子会感染四邻，求全部腐烂所需最少分钟数，做不到返回 -1。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily grid = [[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 所有烂橘子一起入队，BFS 层扩散}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：模拟每一分钟——先数还剩几个新鲜橘子，再拍一张快照，扫全表让每个烂橘子把它四邻的新鲜橘子改烂，一分钟一次，直到没有新鲜橘子。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每一分钟都要整表扫两遍，最坏要模拟 O(mn) 分钟，总代价 O((mn)$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：这本质是多源最短路，把所有烂橘子一起入队做 BFS，一层就是一轮感染。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 注意最后一轮没有新感染时不要多算一分钟，循环条件要带 fresh；结束时 fresh 还大于 0 就返回 -1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}最后一轮没有新感染时不要多算一分钟，循环条件要带 fresh。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cols}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{grid}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{grid}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{minutes}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{fresh}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{grid}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{fresh}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\vsline{16}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{rows}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{17}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cols}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{18}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{snapshot}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[课程表]{课程表（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 207}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定课程数及先修关系，判断能否修完全部课程。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily numCourses = 2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} prerequisites = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 入度为零入队，能删完就无环}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：维护一个「已修课程」集合，反复扫描所有课程，哪门的先修课都已修完就把它加进来，直到某一轮一门都加不进为止。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每修掉一门才可能解锁下一门，最坏要扫 O(V) 轮，每轮 O(V+E)，总代价 O(V(V+E))。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成拓扑排序——统计入度，入度为 0 的课直接入队，出队时把后继入度减一，减到 0 就入队。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(V+E)，空间 O(V+E)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 判断依据：出队数量等于课程总数说明没有环；边方向别建反，[a,b] 表示 b 指向 a。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(V+E)，空间 O(V+E)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}边方向别建反：prerequisites[i] = [a,b] 是 b 指向 a。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[实现 Trie（前缀树）]{实现 Trie（前缀树）（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 208}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}实现 Trie，支持插入单词、查询完整单词和查询前缀。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily insert apple,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} search app,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} startsWith app $\rightarrow$ false,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一条边一个字符，词尾打个标记}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：直接把插入过的单词塞进一个列表，search 就一个个比，startsWith 就挨个取前缀比。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次查询都要把所有单词翻一遍，插入 n 个长度为 L 的单词后，单次查询 O(n·L)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把这批单词的前缀共用起来变成一棵树——每个节点一个 children 字典，沿字符往下走。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(L)（L 为单词长度，与已存单词数无关），空间 O(总字符数)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 词尾要打一个结束标记，否则 search(app) 会把 apple 误判成命中。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(L)，空间 O(总字符数)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}search 不能只看路径存在，必须词尾有标记，否则 app 会误判。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　46 全排列，78 子集，17 电话号码的字母组合，39 组合总和，22 括号生成，79 单词搜索，131 分割回文串，51 N 皇后\par}

\section[全排列]{全排列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 46}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定不含重复数字的数组，返回它的所有全排列。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 逐个位置试数，用过的跳过}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每个位置都把 nums 里所有数试一遍，凑满 n 个再看这串是不是一个排列，是就收下。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在完全不管「这个数用过了没有」，一共枚举 n$^{n}$ 条序列，其中绝大多数不是排列，每条还要排序校验，代价 O(n$^{n}$·n log n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：加 used 数组剪枝——已经放进 path 的数直接跳过，这样每条分支都只在往答案上走。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n·n!)（共 n! 个答案，每个拷一份 O(n)），空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 收集答案要写 path[:]；递归返回后记得把 used 恢复成 False。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·n!)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}收集答案要写 path[:]，直接 append 最后全是同一个列表。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{不剪枝：凑满}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个才回头检查是不是恰好用齐了每个数}}

\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[子集]{子集（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 78}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给一个元素互不相同的数组，返回它的所有子集。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每个元素选或不选，两种分支}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：n 个数选不选只有 2$^{n}$ 种情况，那就用 0 到 2$^{n}$-1 当编号，逐位判断这一位取不取。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个子集都要把 n 个二进制位重新判断一遍、重新拼一个列表，时间 O(n·2$^{n}$)，常数偏大。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成回溯，沿下标往后走，path 上只做 append / pop，走到哪就把当前 path 收一份。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间同为 O(n·2$^{n}$)（答案本身就有这么多元素），但省掉了反复移位判断，额外空间只有 O(n) 递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 进入递归先收答案（含空集）；从 i+1 继续，保证每个子集只出现一次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 位掩码按下标组合升序输出，回溯是深度优先的顺序，两者的输出顺序不同；子集与顺序无关，两种都正确。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}结果要拷贝 path；子集与顺序无关，别写成排列的枚举。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{给每个子集编个号：0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{到}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{2\textasciicircum{}n-1，二进制第}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{位为}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{就表示取}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{nums[i]}}

\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{mask}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\&}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}

\section[电话号码的字母组合]{电话号码的字母组合（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 17}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按电话键盘的数字到字母映射，返回数字串能组成的所有字母组合。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily digits = "23" $\rightarrow$ ["ad",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"ae",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"af",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"bd",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"be",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"bf",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"cd",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"ce",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"cf"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一位数字一层，逐层展开字母}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从 [] 出发，每读一位数字就把当前所有组合都和该位的字母拼一遍，整体换成新列表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每一轮都要把上一轮的中间结果整表复制、重新拼字符串，位数越多重建次数越多，常数和内存分配都吃亏。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成回溯，path 只维护一条正在走的路径，走满 digits 长度就 join 一次收进答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间同为 O(4$^{n}$)（答案个数就是 4$^{n}$ 量级），但额外空间只要 O(n)，不会一轮一轮重建中间表。\par}
\item {\smallfont digits 为空必须返回 []，不能返回 [""]，否则多一个空答案。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(4\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}空串必须返回 []，不能返回 [""]，否则多一个空答案。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsstr}{"2"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"abc"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"3"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"def"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"4"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"ghi"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"5"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"jkl"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsstr}{"6"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"mno"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"7"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"pqrs"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"8"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"tuv"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"9"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"wxyz"}\textcolor{vstext}{,}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{\}}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{朴素：从空串开始，一位一位把已有的组合整体翻新一遍}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{d}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{digits}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prefix}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{table}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{d}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prefix}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{letterCombinations}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{digits}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[组合总和]{组合总和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 39}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}从无重复候选数中选数（可重复），和为 target，返回所有组合。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily candidates = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 7 $\rightarrow$ [[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 可重复选就传 i，避免重复就传 i+1}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每次都从 candidates 的第 0 个开始试，能选就选（可以重复选），和正好到 target 就把这条路径排序后丢进集合去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在同一组数字的不同排列被反复枚举，路径数远多于答案数，还要额外排序去重，数据一大就爆。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：回溯时带一个起始下标 start，本层只从 start 往后选；递归传 i 允许重复用同一个数，传 i+1 就禁止重复。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序后一旦 candidates[i] > remain 直接 break，剪掉整段无用的分支。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间与答案规模成正比（远小于朴素版），空间 O(target) 递归栈。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(S)，空间 O(target)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}传 i+1 会漏掉重复选；传 0 会产生重复组合。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{combinationSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{candidates}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{remain}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{remain}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{不剪枝：不同顺序也当成新路径，最后排序去重}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{tuple}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{remain}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{candidates}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{remain}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[括号生成]{括号生成（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 22}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给括号对数 n，生成所有合法的括号组合。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 3 $\rightarrow$ ["((()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{})\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{})\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"(()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{})\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"(()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{})\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}(()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{})\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左括号没满能加，右少于左才能加}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：长度 2n 的括号串一共 2\textasciicircum{}(2n) 个，全部枚举出来，每个再扫一遍判断是否配平。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在绝大多数串从头就不合法（第一个是右括号），却都老老实实生成到底，多枚举了约 n\textasciicircum{}1.5 倍的无用串，每个还要 O(n) 校验。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把合法性检查提前到生成过程中——左括号没用满就能加左括号，右括号数小于左括号数才能加右括号。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间从 O(4$^{n}$·n) 降到只和答案数（卡特兰数 O(4$^{n}$/n\textasciicircum{}1.5)）成正比，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 右括号的条件写成 right < n 会生成非法串，必须是 right < left。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(4\textasciicircum{}n/$\surd$n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}右括号条件写成 right < n 会生成非法串。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{5}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[单词搜索]{单词搜索（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 79}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断单词能否由网格中相邻格按序连成，同一格不能重复使用。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily board = [["A",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"B",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"C",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"E"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["S",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"F",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"C",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"S"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["A",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"D",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"E",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"E"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} word = "ABCCED" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每个格子当起点，走过就临时涂掉}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每个格子当起点，把所有不重复走格子的路径都走一遍，走满 word 长度了才拿整串和 word 比一次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在完全不等字符对上就往下走，每步四散开枝散叶（最坏约 4·3\textasciicircum{}(L-1) 条路），还要额外用集合记走过的格子。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把判断提前到每一步——当前格字符和 word[i] 不符立刻回头，只往对得上的方向走；走过的格子临时涂成 '\#'，失败再恢复。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn·3\textasciicircum{}L)（最坏同阶，但每一步都被字符剪枝砍掉大半），空间 O(L) 递归栈，且省掉 visited 集合。\par}
\item {\smallfont 恢复现场别漏；单词比格子总数还长时要能尽快失败。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn·3\textasciicircum{}L)，空间 O(L)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}恢复现场别漏；单词长度可能大于格子总数，要能及时失败。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[分割回文串]{分割回文串（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 131}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给字符串 s，把它切成若干子串且每个子串都是回文，返回所有切法。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "aab" $\rightarrow$ [["a",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"a",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"b"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["aa",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"b"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 切一刀先看前缀是不是回文，是就往下切}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从下标 0 出发枚举切点 end，切出前缀 s[start:end+1]，当场用双指针正反比一遍判回文，是回文才继续切剩下的。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每切一刀都要重新判一次回文，同一个子串在不同分支里被反复判定，整体是 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n) 再乘一个 O(n) 的回文检查，数据一大就超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先用区间 dp 把「任意一段是不是回文」预处理成二维表，判断降到 O(1)，递归里只查表不再比较字符。\par}
\item {\smallfont 回文表按长度递推：首尾相等且中间那段是回文即成立，i 从 n-1 倒着填即可。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，优化 O(n$^{2}$) 预处理 + O(2\textasciicircum{}n) 量级的合法切法搜索；空间 O(n$^{2}$) 的表 + O(n) 递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：长度为 1 的单个字符一定是回文；回溯完必须 path.pop()，存答案要 path[:] 拷一份。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}忘 pop 会让路径被污染；存 path 时要拷一份，不能直接塞引用。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[N 皇后]{N 皇后（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 51}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在 n$\times$n 棋盘放 n 个皇后，任意两个不同行、列、斜线，返回所有摆法。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 4 $\rightarrow$ [[".Q..",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"...Q",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"Q...",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"..Q."]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["..Q.",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"Q...",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"...Q",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}".Q.."]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一行摆一个，列和两条斜线各用一个集合查重}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：一行摆一个皇后，试放之前回头扫一遍上面每一行已经放的皇后，看列相同、或者行差等于列差（同一条斜线）就放弃这一格。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每试一格都要和上面所有行比一遍，冲突判断本身是 O(n)，总代价 O(n!·n)，n 一大就很慢。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：冲突其实只有三类键——列 c、主斜线 r-c、副斜线 r+c，用三个集合记「这些位置已经被占了」，判断降到 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 摆满 n 行就是一个解，把每行的列号拼成 ".Q.." 这样的字符串；递归返回时把三个集合里刚加的值删掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n!·n)，优化 O(n!)（每层只付合法分支的代价），空间都是 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：n 为 1 只有一种摆法；n 为 2、3 无解返回空列表；两条斜线的键别写混。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n!)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}两条斜线键写混（r+c 与 r-c）会漏判；回溯忘删集合会污染后续分支。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{solveNQueens}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\section[搜索插入位置]{搜索插入位置（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 35}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给升序无重复数组和 target，找到就返回下标，否则返回它该插入的位置。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 5 $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 就找第一个大于等于 target 的位置，找不到自然落在末尾}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从左往右扫，遇到的第一个大于等于 target 的下标就是答案；扫完都没遇到，说明 target 比所有元素都大，插在末尾。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在一个一个比，最坏要走完整个数组，O(n)，数组长的时候会超时（TLE），完全没用上「已经升序」这个条件。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：换成二分，找第一个 nums[i] >= target 的位置，mid 值小于 target 就 l = mid + 1，否则 r = mid。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n)，优化 O(log n)，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：空数组返回 0；target 小于首元素返回 0；target 比所有元素都大时 l 一路加到 n，正好是插入位置。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}while l < r 配 r = mid 是一套，混用 r = mid - 1 会漏掉答案或死循环。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchInsert}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries ACM 版（完整可运行）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{main.py}{Python}

\vsline{11}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{target}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{idx}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[搜索二维矩阵]{搜索二维矩阵（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 74}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给行内递增、且每行首元素大于上行末元素的矩阵，判断 target 是否存在。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily matrix = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}16,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[23,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}30,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}34,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}60]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 3 $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 当成一维升序数组二分，下标除列宽取行、取余取列}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：两重 for 把整个矩阵从上到下、从左到右扫一遍，碰到 target 就返回 true。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在完全没用上「行内升序、且每行首元素大于上行末元素」，O(m·n) 全扫，数据一大就超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：这两个条件合起来等价于把矩阵按行摊平就是一个升序数组，直接在摊平后的一维数组上二分。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不用真的开新数组：一维下标 k 对应 matrix[k // n][k \% n]，行列映射别写反。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(m·n)，优化 O(log(m·n))，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：m 或 n 为 0 直接 false；二分用 l <= r 的闭区间写法，注意 mid 的边界。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log(m·n))，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}行列映射写反（k//m、k\%m）只有方阵才碰巧对，其余全错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchMatrix}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{row}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{row}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchMatrix}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{matrix}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[在排序数组中查找元素的第一个和最后一个位置]{在排序数组中查找元素的第一个和最后一个位置（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 34}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在非递减数组中找 target 的起始和结束下标，找不到返回 [-1,-1]。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}10]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 8 $\rightarrow$ [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两次二分，一次找最左，一次找最右收工}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从头到尾扫一遍，第一次遇到 target 记下左端点，之后每次遇到就刷新右端点，没遇到就返回 [-1,-1]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在只会在数组上线性走，O(n)，达不到题目要求的 O(log n)，长数组会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把两个端点拆成两次二分——左端点是第一个 >= target 的位置，右端点是第一个 > target 的位置减一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n)，优化 O(log n)，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：先判存在性，左端点越界或该位置的值不等于 target 就直接 [-1,-1]，否则会把不存在的值报成一个区间。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不判存在就直接算右端点，会把不存在的 target 报成一个区间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchRange}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{enumerate}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}}

\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[搜索旋转排序数组]{搜索旋转排序数组（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 33}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在旋转过的升序无重复数组中查找 target 的下标，不存在返回 -1。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 0 $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先看哪半边有序，再判 target 在不在这一段里}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：不管数组转没转，直接从头扫，等于 target 就返回下标，扫完没有就返回 -1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在数组虽然被旋转过，但仍然是「两段升序」，线性扫 O(n) 把这个结构浪费了，数据大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：二分，每次先判断 [l,mid] 和 [mid,r] 哪一半还有序，再看 target 是不是落在那一半的取值区间里，从而只走一边。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n)，优化 O(log n)，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：区间判断的等号不能漏，target 恰好等于端点时会搜错边；循环用 l <= r。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}区间判断漏等号，target 恰好等于端点时会往错的一边搜。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{search}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{enumerate}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[寻找旋转排序数组中的最小值]{寻找旋转排序数组中的最小值（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 153}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}无重复升序数组旋转若干次，返回其中最小元素，要求 O(log n)。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 和右端点比大小，比它大就往右，比它小就留右边界}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：扫一遍把所有元素比一遍，取最小值，O(n)，逻辑上肯定不会错。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在旋转后的数组是「两段升序」，最小值正好是第二段的开头，O(n) 的线性扫没用上这个结构，数据大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：二分，拿 nums[mid] 和 nums[r] 比——大于说明最小值在右半，否则左半（含 mid）还有更小的，交给 r = mid。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(n)，优化 O(log n)，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：旋转了 n 次（等于没转）时答案就是首元素，逻辑照样成立；r = mid 不能写成 mid - 1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}写成 r = mid - 1 会跳过最小值本身，返回偏大的元素。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findMin}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{r}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{r}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mid}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[寻找两个正序数组的中位数]{寻找两个正序数组的中位数（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 4}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给两个升序数组，求合并后的中位数，要求 O(log(m+n))。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2 = [2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2.00000\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 在短数组上二分切点，保证左半恰好放一半元素}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：像归并排序那样，两个指针把两个有序数组合并成一个有序数组，再按下标取中间那个（偶数取中间两个的平均）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在为了找一两个数，把 m+n 个元素全搬了一遍，O(m+n)，题目要求 O(log(m+n))，数据大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不合并，只在较短的数组上二分一条「切线」i，另一半的切线 j = half - i 由「左半正好放 half 个元素」确定。\par}
\item {\smallfont 合法条件是 a[i-1] <= b[j] 且 b[j-1] <= a[i]，越界用 $\pm$inf 当哨兵；合法后按总长奇偶取左半最大或两边界平均。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不合法时 a[i-1] > b[j] 说明 i 偏大，右边界左移，否则左边界右移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 复杂度：朴素 O(m+n)，优化 O(log min(m,n))，空间都是 O(1)。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log min(m,n))，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}二分建在长数组上会让 j 越界；奇偶公式写反中位数就取错半边。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findMedianSortedArrays}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{float}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{extend}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{extend}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\%}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{17}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{float}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{merged}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{/}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[有效的括号]{有效的括号（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 20}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给只含三种括号的字符串，判断是否类型匹配、顺序正确、全部闭合。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\{\}\allowbreak{}" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左括号进栈，右括号必须和栈顶同一对}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 左括号一律入栈；遇到右括号就拿栈顶配对，配不上立刻 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 右括号来时栈已空，说明多了一个右括号，也是 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 扫完后栈必须为空，否则有左括号没闭合。\par}
\item {\smallfont 用字典把右括号映射到对应左括号，比一长串 if-elif 短得多。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：空串算有效；长度是奇数一定无效，可以提前返回。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只看括号种类不看顺序；结尾忘判栈空会放过 "(((" 这种串。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isValid}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pair}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\{}\textcolor{vsstr}{")"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"("}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"]"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"["}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\}"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\{"}\textcolor{vstext}{\}}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pair}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pair}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}}
\end{vscode}

\section[最小栈]{最小栈（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 155}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}设计一个栈，支持 push、pop、top，并能在 O(1) 内取出当前最小值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily push(-2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} push(0)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} push(-3)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} getMin()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ -3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 辅助栈同步记每层的最小值，两栈同进同出}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 主栈正常存元素，另一个辅助栈存“这一层为止的最小值”。\par}
\item {\smallfont push 时辅助栈压 min(val, 辅助栈顶)，保证两栈深度永远一致。\par}
\item {\smallfont pop 时两栈一起弹，辅助栈顶自然回到压入前的状态。\par}
\item {\smallfont 也可以只在新元素更小时才压，但弹栈要额外比值，容易漏。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：空栈不能 pop/top；重复的最小值必须重复压入。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(1)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}辅助栈只在严格更小时压，遇到相等的最小值弹出会错位。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{MinStack}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{3}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{\_\_init\_\_}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{mn}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{7}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{push}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{mn}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{mn}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{mn}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{11}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{mn}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{15}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{top}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{17}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{18}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{getMin}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[字符串解码]{字符串解码（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 394}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按 k[子串] 表示子串重复 k 次的规则，把编码字符串完整解码。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "3[a]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2[bc]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}" $\rightarrow$ "aaabcbc"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 遇 [ 把现场压栈，遇 ] 弹出来乘倍数拼回去}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 一次遍历：数字累积成 k，普通字母拼到当前串 cur。\par}
\item {\smallfont 遇到 [ 就把 (上一层串, k) 压栈，然后清空 cur 和 k 去处理括号内。\par}
\item {\smallfont 遇到 ] 弹栈，cur = 上层串 + k * 当前串，嵌套就一层层还原。\par}
\item {\smallfont 数字可能多位，用 k = k * 10 + int(ch) 累积，别只看个位。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：括号外还有字母（如 ab3[c]）直接拼进 cur，最后返回即可。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(解码后长度)，空间 O(嵌套层数)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}] 时忘了把 k 归零、或写成 k*上层串 + cur，都会拼出错串。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{decodeString}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{stack}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isdigit}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{10}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"["}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{stack}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"]"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{prev}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{num}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{stack}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prev}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{num}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}}
\end{vscode}
