\section[有序数组的平方]{有序数组的平方（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 977}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定非递减整数数组，返回每个元素平方后仍非递减的新数组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [-4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}10]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}16,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}100]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 平方最大在两头，从后往前填}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：先把每个元素平方，再整体排序，一行就能写完。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在白白丢掉了「原数组有序」这个条件：排序要 O(n log n)，n 大时不如线性。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：平方后的最大值一定出现在两端（绝对值大的那个），用双指针 i、j 从两头往中间比，大的先填到结果末尾。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个元素只被取一次，时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)（结果数组）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：结果从后往前填，k 从 n-1 递减；两端平方相等时取哪边都可以。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}别先整体平方再排序，那丢了有序条件，退化成 O(n log n)。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sortedSquares}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[根据数字二进制下1的数目排序]{根据数字二进制下1的数目排序（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1356}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按二进制中 1 的个数升序排列数组，个数相同时按数值升序。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily arr = [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先比 1 的个数，个数相同再比大小}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：把每个数转成二进制字符串，数一数有几个 '1'，把它当第一关键字、数值当第二关键字排序。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个数都要先生成一次二进制字符串；不过时间瓶颈在排序本身，O(n log n) 改不掉，只是常数偏大。\par}
\item {\smallfont 常数优化（不改变复杂度）：用 v \& (v - 1) 每次消掉最低位的 1，循环次数正好等于 1 的个数，比转字符串快。\par}
\item {\smallfont 整体时间 O(n log n)（排序），空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：1 的个数相同的元素内部要按数值升序，所以排序键必须是 (个数, 数值) 元组。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只按 1 的个数排序会打乱同组内部顺序，必须带数值作第二关键字。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sortByBits}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sorted}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{key}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\textcolor{vsctrl}{lambda}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bin}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{count}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{'1'}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[有多少小于当前数字的数字]{有多少小于当前数字的数字（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1365}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}对数组中每个元素，统计比它小的元素个数，按原顺序返回结果数组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序后的首次下标，就是比它小的个数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：对每个数，把整个数组再扫一遍，数一数有多少个比它小。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在同一个数组被扫了 n 遍，O(n$^{2}$)；本题 n $\leq$ 500 还能过，数组再大（1e4 以上）就明显撑不住，所以需要优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：排序后某个值第一次出现的下标，恰好等于比它小的元素个数；用哈希表记下每个值的首次下标，再按原顺序查表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(n log n)，查表 O(1)，总时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：必须记首次出现的下标，记最后一个会让重复元素的答案偏大。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}必须记首次出现的下标，记最后一个会让重复元素的答案偏大。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[重排链表]{重排链表（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 143}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把链表 L0$\rightarrow$L1$\rightarrow$…$\rightarrow$Ln 原地重排为 L0$\rightarrow$Ln$\rightarrow$L1$\rightarrow$Ln-1$\rightarrow$L2$\rightarrow$…\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 找中点、反后半、再交替合并}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：先把所有节点装进一个数组，有了下标就能按 L0$\rightarrow$Ln$\rightarrow$L1$\rightarrow$Ln-1 的顺序直接改 next 指针。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢/浪费在要多开一个 O(n) 的数组；链表题一般要求原地改指针。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：快慢指针找中点 $\rightarrow$ 把后半段断开并反转 $\rightarrow$ 前半段和反转后的后半段交替合并。\par}
\item {\smallfont 三段都是线性扫描，时间 O(n)，额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：合并前先存好两个 next，否则改完指针链就断了；快慢指针的判断写 fast.next 和 fast.next.next。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}快慢指针的判断要写 fast.next 和 fast.next.next，防止空指针。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[移除链表元素]{移除链表元素（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 203}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}删除链表中所有值等于 val 的节点，返回新的头节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily head = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} val = 6 $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 加个虚拟头，删谁都一样}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：头结点也可能被删，先在头上挂一个虚拟头结点，再从头遍历。\par}
\item {\smallfont 这题没有更优算法：每个节点必须看一次，O(n) 是下界；虚拟头只是省掉「删头」特判，不是复杂度优化，所以不再单独给优化版。\par}
\item {\smallfont 做法：cur 从虚拟头出发，只看 cur.next 的值，相等就 cur.next = cur.next.next 把它摘掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：删完 cur 不能前移，否则相邻的连续目标值会被漏删。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}删除后 cur 不能前移，否则相邻的连续目标值会被漏删。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[设计链表]{设计链表（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 707}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}实现链表类，支持按下标取值、头尾插入、指定位置插入与按下标删除。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily addAtHead(1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} addAtTail(3)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} addAtIndex(1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} get(1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 带虚拟头加 size，插删都不特判}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：按题目要求手写单链表——虚拟头结点 + size 计数，所有操作都靠从头走 index 步。\par}
\item {\smallfont 这题没有更优写法：链表按下标访问天然是 O(index)，不引入额外结构就是这个复杂度，所以朴素解就是最终解，不再单独给优化版。\par}
\item {\smallfont 虚拟头让头插、头删不用特判；size 让越界判断和尾插都变成 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 各操作时间 O(index)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：插入删除后都要维护 size；addAtIndex 中 index > size 直接忽略，index < 0 按 0 处理。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}各操作时间 O(index)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}插入删除后都要维护 size；删除要求 0 $\leq$ index < size。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{19}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{20}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{addAtIndex}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{index}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[四数之和]{四数之和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 18}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在数组中找出所有和为 target 且互不重复的四元组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 0 $\rightarrow$ [[-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序后两层定数，剩下两个双指针夹}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：四重循环枚举所有下标组合，和等于 target 就排序后放进集合去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在组合数是 C(n,4) ≈ n$^{4}$/24，n=200 时已是上亿次，必然 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先排序，两层 for 固定前两个数，后两个数交给左右双指针夹逼——和偏小 left 右移，偏大 right 左移，相等收答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间降到 O(n$^{3}$)，空间 O(1)（不计结果）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：每层循环开头去重（i>0、j>i+1 才比较）；target 为负时不能只凭 nums[i] > target 剪枝。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{3}$)，空间 O(1)（不计结果）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}去重条件要写成 i>0、j>i+1，写错会漏解或产生重复。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[快乐数]{快乐数（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 202}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}反复把 n 换成各位数字的平方和，能变成 1 就是快乐数，否则不是。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 19 $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 平方和进集合，重复出现就是死循环}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：严格按定义迭代，把当前数换成各位数字的平方和，同时用一个集合记住走过的数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢/浪费在集合：不是快乐数就一定会绕圈，走过的数会重复出现，判重要多开 O(log n) 的空间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把「x $\rightarrow$ 平方和(x)」看成链表的 next，那么「到不了 1」就等于链上有环，用快慢指针（Floyd）判环即可。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢的每次走一步、快的每次走两步，时间 O(log n)，额外空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：循环条件写成 fast != 1 且 slow != fast；退出后直接看 fast 是否等于 1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}要先判断重复再更新数值；另外 1 本身就是快乐数。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{**}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[同构字符串]{同构字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 205}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断 s 能否按字符一一替换成 t，同字符映射相同、不同字符不得映射同一字符。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "egg",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "add" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 双向映射都要查，单向会放过冲突}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：对每个位置 i，回头把所有 j < i 比一遍，检查「s[i]==s[j]」和「t[i]==t[j]」是否同真同假。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个位置都要回头扫一遍，O(n$^{2}$)，长字符串会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用两张哈希表维护双向映射，s 的字符映射到 t、t 的字符也映射回 s，一旦冲突就返回 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)（字符集有限）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：只建单向映射时 s=ab、t=cc 会被误判成同构，两个方向都要查。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)（字符集有限）\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只建单向映射时，像 s=ab、t=cc 会被误判成同构。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[有效的字母异位词]{有效的字母异位词（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 242}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断 t 是否为 s 的字母异位词，即两串字母的种类和出现次数完全相同。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "anagram",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "nagaram" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 26 格计数，s 加 t 减，最后全零}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：对 s 里出现的每个字符，分别数它在 s 和 t 中出现的次数，有一处不等就返回 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个字符都要把两个串各扫一遍，O(n$^{2}$) 级别。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：只有 26 个小写字母，开一个长度 26 的计数数组——s 的字符加一，t 的字符减一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)（26 个格子）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：长度不等先返回 false；最后检查 26 个计数是否全为 0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}数组大小要按字符集定，下标别写成 ord(ch) 超出 26。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isAnagram}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{count}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{count}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ord}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ord}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{'a'}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\end{vscode}

\section[两个数组的交集]{两个数组的交集（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 349}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求两个数组的交集，结果中每个元素只出现一次，顺序不限。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2 = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一个集合去重，另一个集合判存在}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：遍历 nums1，看每个元素在不在 nums2 里，在、且结果里还没有，就收进来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在「在不在」要线性扫一遍 nums2，每次 O(m)，整体 O(n·m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把 nums2 丢进集合（哈希），判存在 O(1)；结果也放进集合，天然去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(n+m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：同一元素出现多次，结果里也只能留一次，所以结果要用集合而不是列表。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(n+m)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}同一元素在两个数组里出现多次，结果里也只能保留一次。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{intersection}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[赎金信]{赎金信（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 383}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断 ransom 能否只用 magazine 中的字符拼出，每个字符只能用一次。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily ransomNote = "aa",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} magazine = "aab" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 杂志建库存，赎金信逐字扣减}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：把 magazine 当成一堆可消耗的字符，ransomNote 每用一个就从中删掉一个。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在「查找 + 删除」都是线性扫描，n 个字符 $\times$ m 长度，O(n·m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：26 个小写字母开一个 26 格计数数组当库存，先统计 magazine，再逐个扣减 ransomNote。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：库存已为 0 却还要用就返回 false；先判断再扣减，顺序别写反。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}magazine 的字符不能复用，所以必须先扣库存再判断下一位。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{canConstruct}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ransomNote}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{magazine}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pool}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{magazine}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ransomNote}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pool}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{remove}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[四数相加II]{四数相加II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 454}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}四个等长数组，统计有多少个下标元组 (i,j,k,l) 使四数之和为 0。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1=[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2=[-2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums3=[-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums4=[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两两求和存次数，再倒查相反数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：四重循环枚举 (i, j, k, l)，和为零就让计数加一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 n$^{4}$ 次组合，n=200 时是 16 亿次，必然 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两两分组——先枚举 nums1+nums2 的所有和并记下「这个和出现几次」，再枚举 nums3+nums4 去表里查相反数的出现次数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：表里存的是次数不是布尔值，统计的是下标元组个数，不能去重。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n$^{2}$)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}统计的是下标元组个数，不是不同的和的种类数，别去重。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{fourSumCount}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}}
\vsline{3}{12.64em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nums3}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums4}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums3}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{d}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums4}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{d}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{16.86em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}}
\end{vscode}

\section[查找常用字符]{查找常用字符（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1002}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}找出所有在每个字符串中都出现过的字符（含重复），以字符数组返回。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily words = ["bella",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"label",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"roller"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ ["e",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 26 格逐串取最小频率，再摊开}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 最直接：拿第一个串的每个字符，去后面每个串里找，找到就收进答案，并从每个串里删掉一个该字符。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次「查找 + 删除」都要扫一遍字符串，整体 O(k·L$^{2}$) 级别，字符串一长就慢。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：26 个小写字母开计数数组，第一个串的频率当基准，后面每串的频率逐位取最小值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(k·L)，空间 O(1)（26 个格子）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：取的是每个字符在各串中的最小出现次数，不是「是否出现过」；最后按字母序摊开。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(k·L)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}取的是每个字符在各串中的最小次数，而不是它是否出现过。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[独一无二的出现次数]{独一无二的出现次数（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1207}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}统计数组中每个数的出现次数，判断这些次数是否互不相同。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily arr = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先数频率，再把频率去重比个数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：对每种数字都两层循环数它出现了几次（同一个数只数第一次），O(n$^{2}$)；再两两比较这些次数看有没有重复。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在一个数被反复数：n 个位置每个都扫一遍数组，次数之间又要两两比，n 上万就 TLE，需要后面的优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用哈希表一次遍历把频率数完，再把频率丢进 set 去重，集合大小等于频率个数就说明互不相同。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：只有一种数字时频率集合只有一个元素，必定为 true；判断的是次数重复，不是数字重复。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}判断的是次数之间是否重复，不是数字本身是否重复。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{uniqueOccurrences}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{每种数字都重新数一遍它出现了几次}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{freqs}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{3.61em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{同一个数只数第一次}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{freqs}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{再两两比较，看有没有两个数出现次数相同}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{freqs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{12.5}{16}\selectfont 这一类输入怎么读}\par\vspace{3pt}

\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　剑指 替换空格，剑指 左旋转字符串，28 找出字符串中第一个匹配项的下标，151 反转字符串中的单词，344 反转字符串，459 重复的子字符串，541 反转字符串II，844 比较含退格的字符串，925 长按键入\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[替换空格]{替换空格（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}剑指 Offer}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把字符串 s 里的每个空格替换成 \%20，返回替换后的字符串。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "We are happy." $\rightarrow$ "We\%20are\%20happy."\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先数空格扩容，再从后往前填 \%20}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：新建结果串，逐字符扫 s，遇到空格就往后接 \%20，否则接原字符。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 Python 字符串不可变：每次 res = res + ... 都要把已有内容整段复制一遍，总代价 O(n$^{2}$)，长串会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：用列表把字符片段收集起来，最后 join 一次拼成串，拼接只发生一次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：没有空格时原样返回；一个空格要扩成三个字符，顺序是 \%、2、0，别写反。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}写入顺序是 \%、2、0 三个字符，别写反；扩容长度要加 2 倍空格数。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{replaceSpace}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\%20"}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{replaceSpace}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\%20"}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{3}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{main}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{lines}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{stdin}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{read}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{splitlines}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{lines}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{lines}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}}

\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{out}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\%20"}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{out}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{print}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{out}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[左旋转字符串]{左旋转字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}剑指 Offer}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把字符串前面的 n 个字符移到末尾，返回左旋转后的字符串。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abcdefg",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} n = 2 $\rightarrow$ "cdefgab"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 前段反、后段反、整体再反，就是左移}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：左移一位就是把第一个字符搬到末尾，重复 n 次；n 先对串长取模。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次搬动都要把后面所有字符往前挪一格（pop(0) 是 O(len)），n 次就是 O(n$^{2}$)，长串会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把串看成前后两段，先在原地分别翻转两段，再整体翻转一次，段内顺序刚好恢复。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)（转成列表那一步除外）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：n 为 0 时原样返回；空串要单独处理，否则对长度取模会除零。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只做两次局部翻转、漏掉整体翻转，得到的是反过来的串。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[找出字符串中第一个匹配项的下标]{找出字符串中第一个匹配项的下标（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 28}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在 haystack 里找 needle 第一次出现的下标，找不到返回 -1。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily haystack = "hello",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} needle = "ll" $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 失配只退模式串，主串指针永不回头}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：枚举主串每个起点 i，从 i 开始和 needle 逐字符比对，全对就返回 i。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在失配后主串指针退回 i+1 从头比，最坏每个起点都要比 m 个字符，O(n·m)，长文本会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先求 needle 的 next 数组（最长相等前后缀），失配时只把模式串指针退到 next[j-1]，主串指针永不回头。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)、空间 O(m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：needle 为空返回 0；needle 比 haystack 长时循环一次都不进，直接返回 -1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(m)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}回退的是模式串指针，主串下标 i 不能回退，否则退化成暴力匹配。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{strStr}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{haystack}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{needle}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{haystack}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{needle}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{从}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{开始和}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{needle}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{逐字符比一遍}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{haystack}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{needle}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{strStr}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{haystack}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{needle}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{needle}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\section[反转字符串中的单词]{反转字符串中的单词（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 151}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}翻转字符串里单词的顺序，单词内部不变，多余空格压成一个。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "the sky is blue" $\rightarrow$ "blue is sky the"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 整体翻转再逐词翻转，空格顺手压成一个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：先用 split() 按空白切出单词（自动去掉多余空格），把列表整体逆序，再用一个空格 join 回去。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：没有更慢的常见写法——每个字符至少要看一遍，O(n) 就是下界，这题不需要额外优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：唯一要注意的是必须用无参 split()，它会把连续空格吃掉；手工逐字符扫一遍也是一个等价写法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：全是空格时 split() 得到空列表，返回空串；单词之间的多个空格只会输出一个。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}用 split(' ') 会把连续空格拆成空串，必须用无参数的 split()。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{words}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{split}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{words}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{reverse}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{words}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[反转字符串]{反转字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 344}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}原地反转字符数组 s，只允许使用 O(1) 的额外空间。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = ["h",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"e",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"o"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ ["o",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"l",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"e",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"h"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右指针向中间夹，边走边交换}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：左右指针从两头向中间夹，交换 s[i] 和 s[j]，然后 i 加一、j 减一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：没有更慢的地方——每个字符都必须被读一次，O(n) 就是下界，这题不需要额外优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：双指针原地交换同时满足 O(n) 时间和 O(1) 额外空间，已经是题目要求的最优解。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：长度 0 或 1 时循环体一次都不进；条件写 i < j，写成 i <= j 会把中间元素又换回去。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}循环条件写成 i <= j 会多交换一次，等于把中间元素又换回原位。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{reverseString}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[重复的子字符串]{重复的子字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 459}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断字符串能否由它的某个子串重复多次拼接而成。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abab" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai s+s 掐头去尾，里面还能搜到 s 就成立}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：枚举子串长度 L（必须整除 n），再逐字符检查 s[i] == s[i-L]，全对就说明由长度 L 的子串重复而成。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在长度 L 最多有 n/2 种，每种都要把整串扫一遍，最坏 O(n$^{2}$)，长串会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：s 能由某个子串重复而成的充要条件是 s 在 (s+s) 掐头去尾后还能找到；也可以用 KMP 的 next 数组，看 n 能否被 n-next[n-1] 整除。\par}
\item {\smallfont s+s 写法时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)；KMP 写法同样 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：长度小于 2 的串没有更短的子串，直接返回 false；掐头去尾是为了排除 s 匹配到原来那一段。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}忘记去掉首尾字符，s 总能匹配到 s+s 的前半段，答案恒为 true。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{repeatedSubstringPattern}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{枚举子串长度，必须能整除}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{n}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{L}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\%}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{L}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ok}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{L}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{L}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ok}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ok}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{15}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\end{vscode}

\section[反转字符串II]{反转字符串II（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 541}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每 2k 个字符反转前 k 个，剩余不足 k 个则全部反转。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abcdefg",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 2 $\rightarrow$ "bacdfeg"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 循环步长写 2k，每段只反前 k 个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每 2k 个字符为一段，把这一段的前 k 个翻转；剩余不足 k 个就全部翻转。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：其实没有更慢的写法——每个字符最多被翻一次，O(n) 已经是下界，这题不需要额外优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不用换算法，只要别用计数器累加判断位置，直接让 i 每次跳 2k、让切片自动截断边界。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)（切片会建临时列表）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：k 大于串长时整串被翻一次；剩余恰好 k 个时只翻这 k 个，后面没有字符要保留。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不要用计数器累加判断位置，直接让 i 每次跳 2k，不容易写错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{reverseStr}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries ACM 版（完整可运行）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{main.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{import}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}}
\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{3}{0.00em}{}

\section[比较含退格的字符串]{比较含退格的字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 844}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断两个含 \# 退格的字符串，退格处理之后是否完全相同。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "ab\#c",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "ad\#c" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 遇 \# 就弹栈，最后比两个栈是否一样}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：照着题意用栈模拟，普通字符入栈，\# 就弹掉栈顶（栈空时忽略，等于退格无效），最后比两个栈的内容。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：如果真去字符串里反复找 \# 再删它和前一个字符，每次删除都要搬移后面的字符，O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：栈把「删掉前一个字符」变成 O(1) 弹栈，两个串各扫一遍即可，这就是最直接的模拟。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)；想省空间可以从后往前双指针扫，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：整串被删空时两个栈都为空，返回 true；\# 可能连续出现，弹栈前必须判空。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}\# 可能连续出现，弹栈前必须判空，否则会下标越界。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{backspaceCompare}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{build}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"\#"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{build}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{build}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[长按键入]{长按键入（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 925}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断 typed 是否可能是 name 的某些字符被长按后打出来的结果。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily name = "alex",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} typed = "aaleex" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 逐字符对齐，多出来的必须和上一个相同}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：i、j 两个指针同时扫 name 和 typed，字符相同就一起后移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：字符不同时不能直接判错——typed[j] 可能只是长按多出来的，要和 typed[j-1] 比；漏了这一步会把「alex」和「aaleex」判错。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把长按当成跳过条件，typed[j] == typed[j-1] 就只移 j，否则返回 false；扫完还要检查 name 也扫完了。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：typed 比 name 短一定失败；typed 首字符无法长按，j == 0 时不能走长按分支。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只比较前缀会漏掉 typed 末尾多出的字符，最后要检查 name 是否扫完。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isLongPressedName}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries ACM 版（完整可运行）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{main.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{import}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{sys}}
\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{3}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{check}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{name}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{typed}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\indent{\bodyfont 栈队列题分「表达式求值」（给一整个字符串）和「用栈实现队列」（给操作序列）两类。表达式里的逆波兰式按 token 读，操作符和数字混在一起时统一当字符串判断。\par}

\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　150 逆波兰表达式求值，225 用队列实现栈，232 用栈实现队列，649 Dota2参议院，1047 删除字符串中的所有相邻重复项\par}

\section[逆波兰表达式求值]{逆波兰表达式求值（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 150}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按逆波兰表示法求表达式的值，除法向零取整。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily tokens = ["2",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"1",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"+",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"3",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"*"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 9\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 数字入栈，遇运算符弹两个算完再入栈}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从左往右扫 token，遇到数字就转成整数入栈；遇到运算符就弹出两个数，算完再入栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：没有更慢的常见写法——表达式总得按顺序算一遍，O(n) 是下界；硬改成递归求值反而更绕。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不需要换算法，栈就是这题最直接的模拟；关键是先弹右操作数、再弹左操作数，顺序不能反。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：除法向零截断，Python 的 // 是向下取整，负数要先按绝对值算再补符号。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}-7/2 用 // 得 -4，本题要求 -3，必须按绝对值除完再补符号。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[用队列实现栈]{用队列实现栈（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 225}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}只用队列的基本操作实现栈的 push、pop、top、empty。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily push(1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} push(2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} top()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 入队后把前面的元素全转到队尾，队头即栈顶}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：push 直接入队；pop/top 时把前面 len-1 个元素搬到另一个队列，只留下队尾那个当栈顶。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：每次 pop/top 都要搬 n-1 个元素，连续 n 次操作就是 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把搬运挪到 push——新元素入队后立刻把前面 n-1 个元素依次搬到队尾，队头永远是最新元素。\par}
\item {\smallfont push O(n)，pop/top/empty 都是 O(1)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：空栈不能 pop/top；一个队列就够，另一个只当临时中转。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}push O(n)，pop/top/empty O(1)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}一个队列就够，别为模拟栈申请两个队列还把搬运顺序写反。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
