\section[用栈实现队列]{用栈实现队列（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 232}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}只用栈的基本操作实现队列的 push、pop、peek、empty。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily push(1)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} push(2)\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} peek()\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一进一出两个栈，出栈空了才整批倒过去}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每次 push 都用一个临时栈把已有元素倒出来，把新元素垫到栈底，再把临时栈倒回去。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：一次 push 要倒腾两遍，n 次 push 就是 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两个栈分工，in 只管进、out 只管出；只有 out 空时才把 in 整批倒过去，每个元素一辈子最多倒一次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 均摊时间 O(1)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：out 不空时绝对不能倒，否则顺序被打乱；peek 和 pop 共用同一套倒栈逻辑。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}均摊时间 O(1)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}每次 pop 都倒一次栈会打乱顺序，必须等 out 空了再整批倒。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[Dota2参议院]{Dota2参议院（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 649}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}参议员轮流投票，可禁言一名对手，判断哪一方最终获胜。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily senate = "RD" $\rightarrow$ "Radiant"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两队列存下标，小的先出手，把对手踢掉}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：用一个列表存还活着的议员，谁发言就绕圈找下一个活着的对手，直接把他从列表里删掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：每删一个都要扫一圈找对手、再搬移列表，最多删 n 次，整体 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两个队列分别存 R 和 D 的下标，每次各取队首，下标小的先发言，把对手队首丢掉、自己加 n 后回队尾。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：只剩一个议员时直接获胜；下标加 n 表示下一轮再发言，不用真的模拟轮次。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不要真的按轮去循环整个字符串，用下标加 n 表示进入下一轮更简单。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[删除字符串中的所有相邻重复项]{删除字符串中的所有相邻重复项（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1047}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}反复删除相邻且相同的两个字母，直到删不动，返回结果串。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abbaca" $\rightarrow$ "ca"\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 栈顶相同就弹出，不同就压入}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：按题意把 s 从左到右过一遍，用栈记下还没被消掉的字符；当前字符和栈顶相同就弹栈，否则入栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：如果真去字符串里反复扫描、删掉一对相邻相同字符再从头来，最坏删 n/2 次、每次 O(n)，整体 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：栈把「删除」变成 O(1) 弹栈，栈顶天然就是左边还没被消掉的最后一个字符，一遍扫完。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：全部消完返回空串；栈空时不能弹，要先判空。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}消除后不能用旧下标回退重扫，栈顶本身就是新的相邻字符。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{removeDuplicates}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ch}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{""}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{st}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\chapter{单调栈}
\begin{flushleft}
{\smallfont\color{grayt}II-6　2 题（简单 1，中等 1）\par}
\end{flushleft}
\vspace{2pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{12.5}{16}\selectfont 这一类输入怎么读}\par\vspace{3pt}
\indent{\bodyfont 单调栈题给「n + 数组」或「nums1 + nums2」两个数组。栈里存下标，出栈时才知道答案落在哪一位，所以 ACM 模式只负责把两个数组读进来。\par}
\vspace{4pt}

\vsline{2}{0.00em}{}

\section[下一个更大元素I]{下一个更大元素I（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 496}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}nums1 是 nums2 的子集，求 nums1 每个元素在 nums2 中右边第一个更大值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1 = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai nums2 上跑单调栈，答案记字典再查}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：对 nums1 的每个 x，先在 nums2 里找到它的位置，再从它右边扫第一个比它大的数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：nums1 里每个元素都要把 nums2 扫两遍，O(n·m)，很多比较被重复做，数据大了会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：只对 nums2 跑一次单调栈（栈内从栈底到栈顶递减），元素被弹出时就找到了答案，答案记进字典。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)、空间 O(m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：nums2 严格递减时没有任何元素被弹出，所有答案都是 -1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(m)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不要对 nums2 每个元素都往右暴力找，那是 O(n$^{2}$)，一次单调栈就够。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{nextGreaterElement}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{先在}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{nums2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{里找到}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的位置}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{再从它右边找第一个更大的数}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{16.86em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{16.86em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\{}\textcolor{vstext}{\}}}

\section[下一个更大元素II]{下一个更大元素II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 503}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}环形数组里求每个元素后面第一个更大的数，找不到输出 -1。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}-1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 数组走两遍，下标取模，答案只填前 n 个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：对每个位置 i，从它右边开始绕圈往后找（下标取模），遇到第一个比 nums[i] 大的就记下来。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：每个位置最多要扫 n-1 个数，n 个位置就是 O(n$^{2}$)，会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把数组拉直成 2n 长度跑单调栈，栈里存下标，遇到更大的就弹栈写答案，答案只填前 n 个位置。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：元素全相同或严格递减时答案全是 -1；必须严格大于才弹栈，相等不能弹。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}严格大于才弹栈，遇到相等不能弹，否则相同元素会互相误判。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{nextGreaterElements}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{绕圈往后找，下标取模}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\%}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　100 相同的树，106 从中序与后序遍历序列构造二叉树，110 平衡二叉树，111 二叉树的最小深度，112 路径总和，116 填充每个节点的下一个右侧节点指针，129 求根到叶子节点数字之和，222 完全二叉树的节点个数，235 二叉搜索树的最近公共祖先，257 二叉树的所有路径，404 左叶子之和，450 删除二叉搜索树中的节点，501 二叉搜索树中的众数，513 找树左下角的值，530 搜索树的最小绝对差，538 把二叉搜索树转换为累加树，617 合并两个二叉树，654 最大二叉树，669 修剪二叉搜索树，700 二叉搜索树中的搜索，701 搜索树中的插入操作，1382 将二叉搜索树变平衡\par}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[相同的树]{相同的树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 100}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断两棵二叉树结构相同且每个对应节点的值都相同。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily p = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} q = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两棵树一起递归，空对空、值比值}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：递归同时走两棵树，两个都空返回 true，只有一个空或者值不同返回 false。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：没有更快的做法——必须比完每个节点，O(n) 是下界，这题不需要额外优化。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：保持递归即可，左右子树用 and 连接可以短路，一发现不同就立刻返回。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)，h 是树高（递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：两个空树算相同；节点值可能为负，只比相等不比大小；必须先判空再取 val。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}必须先判空再取 val，否则访问 None 的 val 会直接报错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[从中序与后序遍历序列构造二叉树]{从中序与后序遍历序列构造二叉树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 106}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}根据中序和后序遍历序列构造出唯一的二叉树并返回根节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily inorder = [9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} postorder = [9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 后序末尾是根，按中序切成左右两半}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：后序最后一个元素是根，在中序里找到它的位置 k，左边是左子树、右边是右子树，然后递归。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：每次都用 inorder.index 线性找根，还靠切片切子数组，链状树退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，会 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先用哈希表记下每个值在中序里的下标，查询变 O(1)；递归只传区间下标，不再切片。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：区间为空返回 None；右子树在后序里的右端是 pr-1，左子树的根还要再减去右子树长度。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}左子树根在后序里的位置是 pr-(右子树长度)-1，写成 pr-1 会切错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{buildTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{inorder}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{postorder}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{inorder}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{postorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{每次都在中序里线性找根的位置}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{inorder}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{index}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{postorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{buildTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{inorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{postorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{buildTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{inorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{postorder}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}}
\end{vscode}

\section[平衡二叉树]{平衡二叉树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 110}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断二叉树是否每个节点左右子树的高度差都不超过 1。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 后序求高度，一旦不平衡立刻返回 -1}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从上往下判——先求左右子树高度看差是否超过 1，再递归判左右子树是否平衡。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：求高度要遍历整棵子树，而每个节点又都会当一次根再求一遍高度，链状树退化成 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成后序自底向上，height 一边求高度一边判平衡，不平衡就返回 -1，一次遍历搞定。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：空树和单节点都算平衡；某棵子树一旦返回 -1 就立刻向上短路。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}自顶向下每个节点都重新求一次高度会退化成 O(n$^{2}$)，要边求高度边判断。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isBalanced}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{bool}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{abs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{height}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isBalanced}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{isBalanced}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[二叉树的最小深度]{二叉树的最小深度（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 111}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求根节点到最近叶子节点的最短路径上的节点个数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 只有叶子才算到底，单边空就走另一边}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：递归求最小深度，空节点返回 0，叶子返回 1，其余取左右子树的较小值加 1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：不能直接对左右子树取 min——只有一边为空时，那条空路径不算走到叶子，会错误地返回 1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：所以先单独处理只有一个孩子的情况，交给有孩子的那边继续走；两边都非空才取较小值加 1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：单边链状树要一直走到唯一的叶子；空树返回 0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}把最大深度的 max 改成 min 就交，遇到只有一个孩子的节点会算成 1。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minDepth}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[路径总和]{路径总和（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 112}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断是否存在一条根到叶子的路径，其节点值之和等于目标值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}11,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}13,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} targetSum = 22 $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 边走边减目标值，到叶子看是否减成 0}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：递归往下走，用 targetSum 减去当前节点值，把剩下的和传给子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在哪：必须走到叶子才能判断，中途剩余为 0 不算数；这题递归就已经是 O(n)，没有更快的做法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不用换算法，左右子树用 or 连接可以短路，找到一条就立刻返回。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 边界：节点值和目标值都可能为负，不能靠大小比较提前剪枝；空节点返回 false。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}中途剩余为 0 就返回 true 是错的，路径必须在叶子节点结束。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{targetSum}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{rest}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{targetSum}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{hasPathSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{rest}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{hasPathSum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{rest}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[填充每个节点的下一个右侧节点指针]{填充每个节点的下一个右侧节点指针（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 116}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}完美二叉树中把每一层的节点用 next 串起来，每层最后一个指向空，要求常量额外空间。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\#,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\#,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\#]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 上一层搭好的 next，就是下一层的桥}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：BFS 按层把节点放进队列，每一层里把前一个的 next 指向后一个，时间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在空间：要额外开队列存下一整层，O(n)，不满足题目「常量额外空间」的要求。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：上一层已经用 next 串成了链表，顺着它就能给下一层接线，队列就省了。\par}
\item {\smallfont 左孩子接右孩子；右孩子接 cur.next 的左孩子（cur.next 为空就保持 None）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)：一层接完 cur = cur.left 继续下沉。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}跨父节点那根线要用 cur.next.left，漏掉就只有同一父节点内的连线。朴素版容易把每层最后一个节点的 next 写成下一层第一个，必须保持 None。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[求根到叶子节点数字之和]{求根到叶子节点数字之和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 129}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把每条从根到叶子的路径上的数字依次拼成一个数，求所有路径数字之和。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 25\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 往下走就乘十加当前值，到叶子就收}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：DFS 把每条根到叶子的路径都存成列表，收集完再逐条拼成数字求和，时间 O(n·h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每条路径都复制一份列表，最后还要二次遍历拼接，空间也涨到 O(n·h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把「走到这里已经拼出的数」当参数往下传，进节点就 cur = cur*10 + val，到叶子直接累加。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)，只有递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空节点返回 0；叶子判定放在非空节点上，不能把 None 当一条路径。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}叶子判定要放在非空节点上做，空节点提前返回 0，否则会把 None 算成一条路径。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[完全二叉树的节点个数]{完全二叉树的节点个数（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 222}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给一棵完全二叉树，求节点个数，要求比逐个遍历更快。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左右等高就是整棵满树，公式直接算}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：直接递归数节点，1 + 左子树个数 + 右子树个数，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在完全没用「完全二叉树」这个结构，节点数上亿时必然超时（TLE），还会爆递归栈。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：分别沿左链求左右子树高度；两边等高说明左子树是满的，2\textasciicircum{}h - 1 直接算，只需递归右子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 高度不等说明右子树满，对称地递归左子树；整体 O(log$^{2}$n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 高度只沿 left 指针数，一次 O(log n)，千万别真去遍历整棵子树。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log$^{2}$n)，空间 O(log n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}高度只沿左链数，不要真去遍历整棵子树，否则退化成 O(n)。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{countNodes}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{countNodes}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{countNodes}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[二叉搜索树的最近公共祖先]{二叉搜索树的最近公共祖先（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 235}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在二叉搜索树中给定两个节点，求它们的最近公共祖先节点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} p = 2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} q = 8 $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 第一次落在 p、q 中间，就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：完全不管 BST 有序性，当普通二叉树用 DFS 分别求出根到 p、根到 q 的两条路径，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两条路径从头比，最后一个相同的节点就是答案——但为了两个点跑了两遍全树，还存了路径数组。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：BST 有序，当前值比两个目标都大就往左、都小就往右，第一次「分叉」的位置就是 LCA。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(h)，空间 O(1)（迭代版）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 祖先可以是 p 本身，所以判断用「不同侧」，不要写成严格开区间。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(h)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}祖先可以是 p 本身，判断要写成「不同侧」，别用严格的开区间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[二叉树的所有路径]{二叉树的所有路径（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 257}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}返回二叉树中所有从根节点到叶子节点的路径，节点值用 -> 连接。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ ["1->2->5",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"1->3"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 前序走到底收一条，回头时把尾巴弹掉}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：DFS 把每条根到叶子的路径存成列表，全部收集完再统一转成 'a->b' 字符串。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每条路径都要复制一份列表，最后还要再遍历一遍做拼接，多出 O(路径总长) 的中间空间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：回溯栈里直接存 str，到叶子当场 join，离开节点 pop，不用列表副本也不二次遍历。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n·h)，空间 O(h)（不计结果本身）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 回溯的 pop 必须和递归调用配对，漏掉会串路径。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·h)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}回溯的 pop 必须和递归配对放在一起，漏掉会串路径。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[左叶子之和]{左叶子之和（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 404}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求二叉树中所有左叶子节点值之和，左叶子指父节点的左孩子且本身是叶子。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 24\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 站在父节点上认左孩子，别自己当叶子}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先序遍历把所有节点收进一个数组，再对数组里每个节点检查它的左孩子是不是叶子，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在要多存 O(n) 个节点引用，相当于把整棵树复制一份，还要二次遍历。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：递归时直接站在父节点判断左孩子，不存任何节点列表，边走边累加。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 左叶子的三个条件（有左孩子、左孩子无左孩子、无右孩子）必须同时成立。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}别把「最左边的节点」当左叶子，判断必须三个条件都满足。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nodes}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nodes}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{collect}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{collect}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{collect}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\section[删除二叉搜索树中的节点]{删除二叉搜索树中的节点（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 450}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}删除二叉搜索树中值为 key 的节点，保持 BST 性质，返回新的根。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} key = 3 $\rightarrow$ [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两边都在，就把左子树挂到右子树最左}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：不使用 BST 性质，像普通二叉树一样左右子树都递归去找 key，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 key 只可能在其中一边，朴素版每层两边都走，白跑一半子树。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：比较 key 与当前值，小就走左、大就走右，一条路径走到底，O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 删除仍分三种情况：叶子/单孩子直接顶上来，双孩子把左子树挂到右子树最左（后继）的左边。\par}
\item {\smallfont 递归返回值直接赋给父节点的 left / right，不用记父节点。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(h)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}两边都在时不要新建节点，先把左子树接到右子树最左再返回右子树。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[二叉搜索树中的众数]{二叉搜索树中的众数（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 501}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}找出二叉搜索树中出现频率最高的所有值，顺序不限。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 中序就是有序数组，相同值必然挨着}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：怎么遍历都行，用字典统计每个值出现的次数，最后挑出次数最大的那些，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在完全没用 BST 中序就有序这个性质，还额外花了 O(n) 的哈希表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：中序遍历得到升序序列，相同值必然相邻，只要 pre 和 cnt 两个变量边走边比。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)，只有递归栈，不用哈希表。\par}
\item {\smallfont cnt 超过 best 要清空旧答案，等于 best 才追加。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}cnt 大于 best 时必须清空旧结果，只 append 会留下过期答案。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\{}\textcolor{vstext}{\}}}

\section[找树左下角的值]{找树左下角的值（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 513}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求二叉树最后一行最左边的节点值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 层序遍历，每层第一个就是候选}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：BFS 一层层扫，每层第一个就是候选；用 list 当队列，pop(0) 出队，O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 list.pop(0) 要把后面所有元素往前挪，最坏每层都挪一遍，整体 O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：每层用一个新列表装孩子、整层替换队列，出队不再挪数组，时间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间 O(w)，w 是最大层宽。\par}
\item {\smallfont 不是一路向左走到底：最左的节点不一定在最后一行。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(w)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不是一路向左走到底，最左的叶子不一定出现在最后一行。用 list 当队列时别忘了每层只弹 size 个，否则层就串了。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findBottomLeftValue}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{size}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{size}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{node}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{q}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[搜索树的最小绝对差]{搜索树的最小绝对差（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 530}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求二叉搜索树中任意两个节点值之差的绝对值的最小值。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 中序有序，最小差只在相邻两个里}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把整棵树的值收进数组，二重循环枚举所有节点对求最小绝对差，O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在节点上万时就是上亿次比较，肯定超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：BST 中序遍历天然升序，最小差只可能出现在相邻两个值之间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 递归中序，用 pre 记住上一个值，一趟扫完，时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont pre 第一次是 None，不能直接相减，否则报类型错误。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}pre 第一次还是 None，不能直接相减，否则报类型错误。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{collect}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{16}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{abs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}}

\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[把二叉搜索树转换为累加树]{把二叉搜索树转换为累加树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 538}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把每个节点的值改成原树中所有大于等于它的值之和，返回转换后的根。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [30,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}36,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}21,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}36,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}35,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}26,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}33,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 右中左反着走，一路累加写回}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：中序拿到有序数组，再遍历每个节点，用它自己的值去数组里扫一遍求「大于等于它的和」，O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个节点都重扫一遍数组，n 大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：这个和就是「从大到小的后缀和」，右-中-左遍历正好按降序访问，一个 total 一路累加即可。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 写回的是累加后的 total，不是原来的 val；节点是负数时顺序照样成立。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}顺序必须是右-中-左；写回的值是累加后的 total，不是原来的 val。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[合并两个二叉树]{合并两个二叉树（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 617}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}按位置相加把两棵二叉树合并成一棵，只有一边有节点的位置直接搬过来。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily t1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t2 = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一边空就把另一边整棵交回去}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：同时递归两棵树，缺的一边按 0 算，每个位置都新建一个节点，O(n+m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在一棵树某侧为空时，另一棵的整棵子树还要逐节点复制一遍，多花时间和新建节点。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：一边为空就直接把另一边的整棵子树挂回去，O(1) 完成，节点也能复用。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 返回 t1 / t2 时是整棵子树跟着接上，不是只返回值。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}返回 t2 或 t1 时是整棵子树跟着接上，不能只返回值。朴素版每个位置都新建节点，返回的是新树；优化版直接改 t1 原节点。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[最大二叉树]{最大二叉树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 654}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}用不含重复元素的数组构造最大二叉树：根是最大值，左右递归用两侧子数组。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每层先挑最大值当根，再把数组切两半}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：构造树先定根，所以每层都在当前区间里线性扫一遍找最大值，再按它把数组切成左右两半递归。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每层都要重新扫一遍区间，最坏（数组递增）退化成链，总时间 O(n$^{2}$)，n 大时会超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 更快的写法是用单调栈一趟扫描建树 O(n)，但要维护递减栈、写起来绕；本题 n 很小，朴素版已经够用。\par}
\item {\smallfont 所以这题不另列优化代码：时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n)（递归栈 + 切片）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 递归出口是区间为空而不是长度 1；切片右边界别写反。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}递归出口是区间为空而不是长度 1；切片右边界别写反。用 nums.index(max(nums)) 依赖元素互不相同这个前提。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{index}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{constructMaximumBinaryTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{constructMaximumBinaryTree}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}}

\section[修剪二叉搜索树]{修剪二叉搜索树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 669}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}修剪二叉搜索树，只保留值落在 [low, high] 内的节点，返回新的根。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} low = 1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} high = 2 $\rightarrow$ [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 越界的那一支别扔，还要往回收}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：不看 BST 性质，像普通二叉树那样左右两边都递归修剪，越界节点再把幸存的孩子接回去，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在越界时其实有一整侧必然全废，朴素版还是把它递归了一遍，整棵树永远要全走。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：BST 有序，节点小于 low 时左子树全废、只需递归右子树；大于 high 时只需递归左。\par}
\item {\smallfont 最坏 O(n)，但被整片丢弃的子树一次都不会碰，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 越界时返回的是「修剪后的那一边」，不是 None，否则合格的后代一起丢。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}越界直接 return None 会连同合格后代一起丢掉，这是本题最大的坑。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{3}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{high}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{trim}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{trim}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{right}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{trim}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\vsline{13}{0.00em}{}

\section[二叉搜索树中的搜索]{二叉搜索树中的搜索（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 700}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在二叉搜索树中查找值为 val 的节点，返回以它为根的子树，不存在返回空。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} val = 2 $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 比大小走一条路，不用遍历全树}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：当普通二叉树做前序遍历，左右子树都找，命中就返回，O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在明明 BST 有序，还是可能把整棵树走一遍。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：比较 val 与当前值，小就往左、大就往右，一条路走到命中或空。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(h)，迭代版空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 命中直接返回当前节点，整棵子树随之返回。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(h)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}别按普通二叉树前序遍历，那样白白浪费了 BST 的有序性。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchBST}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{None}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchBST}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchBST}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{searchBST}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{root}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{val}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{right}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}}
\end{vscode}

\section[搜索树中的插入操作]{搜索树中的插入操作（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 701}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}往二叉搜索树中插入一个与现有节点值都不同的新值，返回插入后的根。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} val = 5 $\rightarrow$ [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 顺着大小走到空位，就地挂上}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先不管 BST 的插入规则，把树上每个空位都试一遍，挂上去后用「中序是否升序」验证合法性，O(n$^{2}$)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次尝试都要 O(n) 检查整棵树，最多试 O(n) 个空位，n 大时超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：BST 保证「小往左、大往右」，走到空位就是唯一正确的插入位置，递归一趟即可。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(h)，空间 O(h)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 必须 root.left = ... 接住返回值，否则新节点挂不上去。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(h)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}必须写 root.left = ... 接住返回值，否则新节点挂不上去。朴素版用「试插 + 中序验证」找位置，验证必须查整棵树，只查父子会漏。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[将二叉搜索树变平衡]{将二叉搜索树变平衡（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1382}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把一棵二叉搜索树改造成高度平衡的二叉搜索树，节点值不变，返回任意一种。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 中序拿有序数组，每次取中点重建}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先随便（前序）把值收集起来，再排序得到升序数组，然后每次取中点重建，O(n log n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在多了一次排序，前序遍历本身也没提供任何有序信息，只是拿来收集值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：BST 的中序遍历直接就是升序，省掉排序；拿到数组后每次取中点当根即可保证平衡。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 结果不唯一，中点偏左偏右都能过；闭区间子区间要排除 mid。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}用闭区间时子区间要排除 mid，写成 [lo, mid] 会死循环。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{balanceBST}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{root}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{Optional}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{TreeNode}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{vals}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{preorder}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\chapter{回溯算法}
\begin{flushleft}
{\smallfont\color{grayt}II-8　10 题（中等 7，困难 3）\par}
\end{flushleft}
\vspace{2pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{12.5}{16}\selectfont 这一类输入怎么读}\par\vspace{3pt}
\indent{\bodyfont 补充篇的回溯题输入是「n」「n + k」「n + 数组」或「棋盘/字符串」。解数独这类题要把 9 行棋盘按行读成 char 数组，输出时按行打回字符串。\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\begin{vscode}{template.py}{Python}

\vsline{5}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\noindent{\bodyfont\textbf{输出注意}　二维结果统一「先方案数，再每行一个方案」；解数独输出 9 行字符串。\par}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\textbf{本章题单}　37 解数独，40 组合总和II，47 全排列II，52 N 皇后 II，77 组合，90 子集II，93 复原IP地址，216 组合总和III，332 重新安排行程，491 递增子序列\par}
\vspace{4pt}
\vspace{2pt}
\section[解数独]{解数独（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 37}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}填满 9$\times$9 数独的空格，每行、每列、每宫 1-9 各出现一次，保证解唯一。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily board 首行 "53..7...." $\rightarrow$ 解出首行 "534678912"，\allowbreak{}共 9 行填满\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 空格试 1-9，不行就退回上一个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：还是逐格试 1-9，但每填一个数就现场扫一遍它所在的行、列、宫，判断有没有冲突，O(9\textasciicircum{}m·27)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次判断都要扫 27 个格子，搜索树一大就成倍放大，很容易超时（TLE）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：开局把行、列、宫已有的数字装进三个集合，判断冲突 O(1)，回溯时增删。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(9\textasciicircum{}m)（m 为空位数，配合剪枝远小于上界），空间 O(m)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 九个数字试完必须 return False，漏了会无限递归。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(9\textasciicircum{}m)（m 为空位数），空间 O(m)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}九个数试完必须 return False，漏了这一句会无限递归下去。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
