\section[组合总和II]{组合总和II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 40}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}数组含重复元素，每个数只能用一次，找出所有和为 target 的不重复组合。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily candidates = [10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 8 $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先排序，同一层跳重复，同一条路径不跳}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：不排序也不去重，每个数「选 / 不选」枚举全部 2\textasciicircum{}n 个子集，和等于 target 就丢进 set，O(2\textasciicircum{}n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在相同的数在不同下标上会被反复枚举，产生大量重复组合，只能靠 set 事后去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先排序让相同数相邻，递归带 start 只往后取，同一层跳过相同值，和超了直接 break。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(2\textasciicircum{}n)（剪枝后实际分支少得多），空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 去重条件必须带 i > start，否则会误剪同一条路径上的重复值。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(2\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}去重条件必须带 i > start，否则会把同一条路径上的相同值也剪掉。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\section[全排列II]{全排列II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 47}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定可能含重复数字的数组，返回所有不重复的全排列。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序加 used，同层相同值只取第一个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：按「每个位置挑一个没用过的数」生成全部 n! 个排列，重复的丢进 set 里过滤，O(n·n!)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在重复数字会让同一个排列被生成多次，n! 全跑完才去掉重复。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先排序让相同数相邻，再用 used 标记；同一层里相同值只取第一个（used[i-1] 为假就跳过）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n·n!)，但重复分支在生成时就被剪掉，不用事后去重，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 去重里 used[i-1] 必须是假，写成真会剪掉本该保留的分支。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·n!)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}去重里 used[i-1] 必须是假，写成真会剪掉本该保留的分支。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[N 皇后 II]{N 皇后 II（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 52}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求 n 皇后不同解法的数量，皇后不能同行、同列、同两条斜线。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 4 $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一行放一个，列和两条斜线各记一张表}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：开一个 n$\times$n 棋盘，按行放皇后，每放一个就扫它的行、列、两条斜线看冲不冲突，O(n!·n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每次判断都要扫 O(n) 个格子，棋盘本身还占 O(n$^{2}$) 空间。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：按行递归天然避免同行，用三个集合分别记住已占的列 c、主对角线 r-c、副对角线 r+c，判断 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n!)，空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两条斜线分别用 r-c 和 r+c 做下标，只记一个会漏判。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n!)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}两条斜线分别用 r-c 和 r+c 做下标，只记一个会漏判。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{totalNQueens}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{board}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsstr}{'.'}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}

\section[组合]{组合（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 77}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}返回 1 到 n 之间所有由 k 个数组成的组合，顺序不限。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 2 $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 从 start 往后取，凑够 k 个就收}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：从 start 开始把 1..n 每个数都试一遍，凑满 k 个就收集，不提前算够不够，O(C(n,k)·k)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在不管剩下的数够不够，很多分支走到一半就凑不满 k，白跑一趟（n 大 k 小时尤其浪费）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：本层最多取到 n-(k-len(path))+1，超过这个上界的起点连循环都不进。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(C(n,k)·k)，空间 O(k)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 剪枝上界的 range 右端要 +1 才是闭区间，写错会漏解。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(C(n,k)·k)，空间 O(k)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}剪枝的上界写错会漏解，range 右端要 +1 才是闭区间。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[子集II]{子集II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 90}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定可能含重复元素的整数数组 nums，返回所有不重复的子集（幂集）。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 排序后同层跳过相同数，同一个树枝上照用}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先排序，然后直接枚举全部 2\textasciicircum{}n 个下标子集，每个都丢进 set，靠 set 自己把值相同的重复子集去掉。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个子集都要复制一遍再算哈希，O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n) 的时间外加同样大的 set 空间；n 稍大就指数爆炸，直接 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：排序后回溯，只在本层跳过相同值（i>start 且 nums[i]==nums[i-1]），从生成源头就不产生重复子集。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化后依然是指数级 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，但搜索树只剩「不重复的那些子集」，常数小得多，额外空间降到 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 关键：去重看的是树层（i>start），同一树枝上相同的数照样能接着用，所以条件不能写成 i>0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}去重条件是 i>start 而不是 i>0；换成 used 数组版本时容易把树层和树枝判反。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{subsetsWithDup}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{sort}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{set}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{枚举全部}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{2\textasciicircum{}n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个下标子集，值相同的组合交给}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{set}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{去重}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mask}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{tuple}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{mask}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\&}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{sub}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[复原IP地址]{复原IP地址（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 93}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给只含数字的字符串 s，返回所有合法 IP 地址，四段各 0\textasciitilde{}255 且无前导零。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "25525511135" $\rightarrow$ ["255.255.11.135",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"255.255.111.35"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 切四段，每段 0 到 255 且不带前导零}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：在字符串上枚举三个切点 i<j<k，把四段切出来，再逐段校验（长度 1\textasciitilde{}3、无前导零、数值 $\leq$255）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在切点组合有 C(n,3)≈n$^{3}$/6 种，而绝大多数在切第一段时就已经超长或带前导零，白枚举了大量根本不可能的切法，字符串一长就 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：改成回溯，每层只决定「本段」切 1\textasciitilde{}3 个字符，这段非法就 break，进入下一层前就保证了前缀合法。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化后每个位置最多 3 种选择、深度固定 4 层，时间 O(3\textasciicircum{}4)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 长度不在 4\textasciitilde{}12 之间一定无解，可以整棵搜索树都不搜。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(3\textasciicircum{}4)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}非法段要 break 而不是 continue；长度 4\textasciitilde{}12 的预判能挡掉大量无用搜索。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{restoreIpAddresses}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ok}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{seg}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{seg}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{3}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{seg}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seg}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsstr}{"0"}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{seg}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{255}}
\vsline{12}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{四重循环枚举三个切点，切完再逐段校验}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{16}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{17}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{segs}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{18}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{all}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ok}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{segs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{19}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"."}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{join}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{segs}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{20}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[组合总和III]{组合总和III（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 216}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}在 1\textasciitilde{}9 中取 k 个互不相同的数使其和为 n，返回所有组合，不能重复。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily k = 3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} n = 7 $\rightarrow$ [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 1 到 9 选 k 个，正好凑出 n 就收，超了剪掉}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：1\textasciitilde{}9 每个数只有「选」和「不选」两种，递归枚举全部 2\textasciicircum{}9 个子集，最后再筛出个数等于 k、和等于 n 的。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在搜索过程完全不管已选几个、和是多少：选到第 5 个数、和早就超过 n 了还在继续往下搜，白白跑大量分支。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：递归时直接带着「还要选几个数 count」和「还差多少和 target」两个量，任一变成负数就立刻返回。\par}
\item {\smallfont 再加两个剪枝：当前数已大于剩余和就 break（后面的数更大），剩下的数不够 count 个也 break；时间 O(C(9,k)·k)、空间 O(k)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 本题 2\textasciicircum{}9 只有 512 种，朴素写法不会真的超时，但同样的思路换成「从 n 个数里选 k 个」就会爆炸，所以剪枝必须会。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(C(9,k)·k)，空间 O(k)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}两个剪枝都要写；k 大于 9 或 n 太小会搜出空结果，返回前不必特判。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{combinationSum3}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{9}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{不选}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{选}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{path}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{pop}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}

\section[重新安排行程]{重新安排行程（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 332}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定机票 [from,to] 列表，从 JFK 出发用完所有票，返回字典序最小的行程。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily tickets = [["JFK",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"MUC"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["MUC",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"LHR"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["LHR",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"SFO"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["SFO",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"SJC"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ ["JFK",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"MUC",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"LHR",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"SFO",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"SJC"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 目的港升序取最小，搜到底再倒序拼路径}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：DFS 枚举所有「恰好用完全部机票」的走法，每走完一条就把整条路径拉出来比字典序，保留最小的那条。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在走法数量是阶乘级：同一批票的不同使用顺序被当成不同方案反复枚举，票一多就指数爆炸、必然 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：本质是求有向图的欧拉路径（机场是点、机票是边）。把每个出发地的目的港降序排序，每次取列表末尾（字典序最小）的边走，后序收集节点，最后整体反转。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(E log E)，每条边只走一次 O(E)，合计 O(E log E)、空间 O(E)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 关键：直接一路贪心最小会走进死胡同，必须「先递归走完、回来再记录当前机场」，反转后的序列才正确。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(E log E)，空间 O(E)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}按字典序贪心直接走会走进死胡同，必须后序收集再反转（欧拉路径套路）。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{enumerate}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{tickets}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[递增子序列]{递增子序列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 491}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}找出数组里所有长度至少为 2 的递增（非递减）子序列，结果不能重复。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 不排序，每层拿 set 挡重复值，只挑非递减的}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：枚举全部 2\textasciicircum{}n 个下标子集，去掉长度不足 2 的、去掉不递增的，剩下的用 set 去重。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个子集都要复制一遍、判一遍递增、再算一次哈希，O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)；重复值多时同一个子序列还会被反复造出来，n 稍大直接 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：不排序，回溯时给每一层开一个 set 记录本层用过的值，重复值直接跳过；只有当前值不小于路径末尾时才继续递归。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间仍是指数级 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，但只沿着「已经是递增前缀」的分支往下走，实际搜索量和常数都小很多，额外空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 千万别排序：一排序所有子序列都递增了，结果全错；无序数组上也没法用全局 used 数组去重，只能每层开 set。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·2\textasciicircum{}n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}千万不要排序，排完序所有子序列都递增；无序数组上全局 used 数组去重会失效。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{add}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{tuple}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{seq}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{list}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\section[买卖股票的最佳时机II]{买卖股票的最佳时机II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 122}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定每日股价，可多次买卖但同一时间只能持一股，求能获得的最大利润。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily prices = [7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 7\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 把所有相邻两天的上涨差价加起来就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：干脆「每天都买卖」——只要今天比昨天贵，就当作昨天买、今天卖，把差价直接累加。\par}
\item {\smallfont 这样天天交易看起来又傻又贪，但一段连续上涨的收益正好等于相邻两天差价之和，拆开算和一次性持有完全等价，所以它本身就是最优解。\par}
\item {\smallfont 既然朴素写法已经是 O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间，没有更优的做法，本题不再另给优化版；想换成持有/不持有两状态 DP，结果也一样。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：只累加正差价，跌的那天不交易；长度为 1 时循环进不去，自然返回 0。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只累加正差价；跌的那一天不要算进收益，也别漏掉第一天不能卖的限制。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxProfit}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{profit}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{昨天买、今天卖：今天更贵就落袋}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{profit}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{profit}}
\end{vscode}

\section[加油站]{加油站（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 134}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}环路上第 i 站有 gas[i] 升油，开到下一站耗 cost[i] 升，求能绕一圈的起点。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily gas = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} cost = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 总和不够就返回 -1，够就 reset 到耗尽点的下一站}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：以每个站为起点，老老实实模拟绕一整圈，中途油量变负就换下一个起点。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个起点最多走 n 步，最坏 O(n$^{2}$)，站点上万就 TLE；而且相邻起点之间重复走了大量一模一样的路段。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先看「总加油量 - 总耗油量」，为负直接返回 -1；否则一次遍历累加当前剩余油量，一旦变负就把起点改成 i+1、剩余清零——说明从这段里的任何一站出发都到不了下一段。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)，每个站只被扫过常数次。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：重置的起点是 i+1 不是 i；忘了先判总油量为负会返回错误下标。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}reset 的起点是 i+1 而不是 i；忘了判总油量是否为负会返回错误下标。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{canCompleteCircuit}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{gas}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{gas}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{start}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{tank}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}

\section[分发糖果]{分发糖果（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 135}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每个孩子至少 1 颗糖，相邻孩子中评分高的必须更多，求最少需要的糖果总数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily ratings = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 5\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 左到右补上升，右到左补下降，第二趟取 max}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先每人发 1 颗，然后反复从左到右、从右到左检查，发现「评分更高却糖不多」就给他加一颗，直到某一轮完全没人需要加。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每轮修正只能把一个位置抬高 1 颗，遇到 [1,2,3,...,n] 这种长上坡要来回扫 O(n) 轮，总复杂度 O(n$^{2}$)，n 上万就 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：其实两个方向各扫一遍就够——左到右只保证「右边比左边高」，右到左只保证「左边比右边高」，第二趟取 max 而不是覆盖。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两趟结束所有约束同时满足，时间 O(n)、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：右往左那趟必须取 max，直接赋值会把第一趟已经满足的左邻约束改坏；评分相等时不加糖。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}右往左那趟直接赋值而不取 max 是经典错误；相等评分不加糖。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{candy}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ratings}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{ratings}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{candy}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}

\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ratings}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ratings}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{candy}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{candy}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{candy}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{candy}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{16}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{changed}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[摆动序列]{摆动序列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 376}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求数组的最长摆动子序列长度，相邻元素的差值必须正负严格交替。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 只数趋势拐点，平坡不计，答案至少是 1}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：动态规划。up[i] 表示以 i 结尾、最后一步向上走的最长摆动长度，down[i] 同理，对每个 i 往前枚举所有 j 做转移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个 i 都要回头看前面所有元素，O(n$^{2}$)，n 上万就 TLE；但真正有用的只是「上一个差值是正是负」这一位信息。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：一次遍历，边算差值边维护上一个非零差值的符号，符号翻转就说明多了一个摆动点；差值为 0 的平坡跳过，不改变方向。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：答案至少是 1，长度小于 2 直接返回长度；全相等的数组答案是 1。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}全相等数组答案是 1；只在符号真正翻转时计数，别把平坡当成摆动。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{wiggleMaxLength}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{up[i]/down[i]：以}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{结尾、且最后一步向上/向下的最长摆动序列长度}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{up}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{down}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{up}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{up}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{up}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{up}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{down}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[根据身高重建队列]{根据身高重建队列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 406}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给 [身高, 前面不矮于自己的人数] 数组，重建出满足条件的队列并返回。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily people = [[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 高的先站好，按 k 插进去，矮的插前面不影响}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：先按身高降序（同身高按 k 升序）处理，每个人先塞到队尾，再一步步往前挪，每挪一步就重新数一遍他前面不矮于他的人数，数到正好是 k 就停。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每插一个人最多挪 n 步、每步还要重数 n 个人，最坏 O(n$^{3}$)，n=2000 时根本跑不动。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：注意到排好序之后队列里的人全都不矮于当前这个，所以「前面不矮于他的人数」恰好就等于他该插入的下标；直接 queue.insert(k, person) 一步到位。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n$^{2}$)（insert 本身要搬元素）、空间 O(n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：排序必须是身高降序 + k 升序，两者写反会让同身高的人互相挤错位置。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n\textasciicircum{}2)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}排序必须身高降序且 k 升序；两者写反会让同身高的人互相挤错位置。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{reconstructQueue}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{people}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{people}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{sort}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{key}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\textcolor{vsctrl}{lambda}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{person}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{people}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{先塞到队尾，再一步步往前挪}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{person}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{while}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{每挪一步都重新数一遍他前面不矮于他的人数}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{person}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{person}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{16}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{break}}
\vsline{17}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{18}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pos}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{19}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{queue}}
\end{vscode}

\section[无重叠区间]{无重叠区间（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 435}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定区间数组，求最少移除多少个区间，才能让剩下的区间互不重叠。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily intervals = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 按右端点排队，能留就留，冲突就删一个}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：答案 = 总数 - 最多能留下几个互不重叠的区间，于是用 DP：dp[i] 表示以第 i 个区间结尾最多能留几个，对每个 i 往前枚举 j 转移。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在 O(n$^{2}$) 的两层循环，每个区间都要往前看一遍，n 大一点就超时。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：贪心。按右端点升序排序，能留就留——上一个留下的区间右端 end，当前区间左端 $\geq$ end 就保留并更新 end，否则必须删掉一个。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(n log n)、扫描 O(n)，总共 O(n log n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：端点相接不算重叠（[1,2] 和 [2,3] 可以共存），所以判断用 a >= end；按左端点排序也能做，但保留时 end 要取 min。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}判断冲突用「左端 < end」；按左端点排序也能做，但保留时 end 要取 min。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}

\vsline{13}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[用最少数量的箭引爆气球]{用最少数量的箭引爆气球（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 452}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}气球用 [start,end] 表示，一支箭可穿透多个，求引爆全部气球的最少箭数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily points = [[10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}16]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}6]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}12]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 按右端排好队，一箭尽量穿到底再换箭}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：一支箭能同时扎爆的气球一定两两相交，所以「最少箭数」等于「最多能挑出多少个两两不重叠的气球」。用 DP 求这个最大不重叠集合：dp[i] 表示以第 i 个气球结尾最多挑几个。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在要两层循环枚举前驱，O(n$^{2}$)，气球一多就 TLE；而且为了求一个计数，绕了一大圈 DP。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：直接贪心扫一遍。按右端点升序排序，第一支箭放在第一个气球的右端，后面某气球左端大于箭的位置就说明射不到，箭数加一、箭移到它的右端。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(n log n)、扫描 O(n)，总共 O(n log n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：端点相接的气球能被同一支箭穿透，所以 DP 里要用严格小于 points[j][1] < points[i][0] 判「不重叠」，贪心里用 a > pos 判「射不到」。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}判断条件是「左端 > 箭的位置」；更新箭位用当前区间的右端，别用左端。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findMinArrowShots}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{points}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{not}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{points}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{points}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{sort}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{key}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\textcolor{vsctrl}{lambda}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{points}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{最少箭数}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{最多能挑出多少个两两不重叠的气球}}

\section[分发饼干]{分发饼干（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 455}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}孩子胃口 g、饼干尺寸 s，每块饼干最多给一个孩子，求最多能满足几个孩子。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily g = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} s = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 都排序，小饼干先喂小胃口，喂不动就换大饼干}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：一个孩子一个孩子地喂。对每个孩子扫一遍所有饼干，找出「能满足他的最小那块」，喂掉并打上已用标记。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个孩子都要把饼干数组扫一遍，O(n·m)，数据一大就 TLE；而且每次都在重复找同一批最小值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：两个数组都升序排序，用双指针从小到大配对——饼干 s[j] 能满足 g[i] 就两个指针都后移，否则只换更大的饼干。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(m log m + n log n)、配对 O(m+n)，空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：必须小饼干配小胃口；拿大饼干去喂小胃口，后面的大胃口就没人管了，这是本题最容易贪错的地方。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m log m + n log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}必须小饼干配小胃口；用大饼干去喂小胃口会让后面的大胃口无人可喂。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findContentChildren}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{g}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{对每个孩子，扫一遍所有饼干，找能满足他的最小那块}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{need}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{g}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{need}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{res}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{res}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{g}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[单调递增的数字]{单调递增的数字（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 738}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给非负整数 n，求不大于 n 且各位数字从左到右单调递增的最大整数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 332 $\rightarrow$ 299\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 找到降位前一位减一，后面全变 9}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：从 n 开始一个一个往下减，对每个数逐位检查是否从左到右单调递增，第一个满足的就是答案。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在答案可能离 n 很远（比如 n=1000000000 附近要退几十万步），每步还要 O(log n) 判一遍，n 大时必然超时。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：直接改数位。转成字符数组从右往左扫，发现 s[i-1] > s[i] 这个降位，就把 s[i-1] 减一并把 i 及之后全部置成 '9'；减一可能造出新的降位，所以继续往左扫。\par}
\item {\smallfont 只需扫一遍数位，时间 O(log n)、空间 O(log n)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：只处理最右边那个降位是不够的，要一路往左修正，否则 332 会被改成 329；前导 0 在转 int 时会自动去掉，如 100 $\rightarrow$ 99。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(log n)，空间 O(log n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}只处理第一个降位不够，要一路往左修正；否则 332 会被改成 329。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ok}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{False}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{9}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{ok}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\end{vscode}

\section[柠檬水找零]{柠檬水找零（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 860}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每杯柠檬水 5 美元，顾客依次付 5/10/20 美元，判断能否给每位正确找零。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily bills = [5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 收 20 先花 10 再花 5，5 块的最金贵}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：不预设哪种找法更好，收到 20 元时把「找 10+5」和「找 5+5+5」两条路都递归试一遍，哪条能走完就返回 true。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在每个 20 元都分叉，最坏要试 2\textasciicircum{}(20元的个数) 条路径，顾客一多就指数爆炸、直接 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：贪心定下优先级——20 元优先找 10+5，实在没有 10 元才用三张 5 元；因为 5 元最通用，能应付 10 元和 20 元两种找零，10 元只能用于 20 元。\par}
\item {\smallfont 只需一次遍历、常数个计数器，时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：找零顺序反了（先试 5+5+5）会在 [5,5,10,10,20] 上判错；手上 20 元不用参与找零，所以不用计数。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}20 元找零必须先试 10+5 再试 5+5+5；顺序反了会在 [5,5,10,10,20] 上判错。\par}

\section[监控二叉树]{监控二叉树（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 968}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}节点上的摄像头能覆盖自身、父节点和直接子节点，求覆盖整棵树的最少摄像头数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 自底向上后序贪心，摄像头放在叶子的父节点}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：把所有节点收集成列表，枚举每个节点「放 / 不放」摄像头，共 2\textasciicircum{}n 种方案，逐个检查是否覆盖了全部节点，记下最小的那个数量。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在方案数是指数级 2\textasciicircum{}n，每检查一种还要再扫一遍节点判断覆盖，n=1000 时完全不可行。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：自底向上后序贪心。用三个状态表示节点——0 无覆盖、1 装有摄像头、2 已被覆盖；左右孩子都被覆盖时本节点先记 0 留给父节点，只要有一个孩子无覆盖就必须在本节点装摄像头。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个节点只访问一次，时间 O(n)、空间 O(h)（递归栈）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：空节点要当成「已被覆盖」（否则叶子会被迫装摄像头）；递归结束后根节点若仍是 0，要再补一台。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}空节点必须返回「已覆盖」；递归结束后根节点仍无覆盖要再补一台摄像头。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\section[K次取反后最大化的数组和]{K次取反后最大化的数组和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1005}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}可以任选元素取反共 k 次（同一元素可重复），求操作后数组可能的最大和。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} k = 1 $\rightarrow$ 5\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先翻最负的，剩的次数折腾绝对值最小的数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：每次取反都枚举「翻哪一个元素」，k 次全翻完就求一次和，取最大值，共 n\textasciicircum{}k 条路径。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在同一个数被反复翻来翻去，大量重复的子问题被重新算了一遍，n 或 k 稍大就超时。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：贪心。先排序，从最负的数开始翻——负数翻正收益最大，所以优先吃掉所有能吃的负数；k 用完后若还有剩余，就折腾绝对值最小的那个数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 排序 O(n log n)、扫描 O(n)，总共 O(n log n)、空间 O(1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：剩余 k 为偶数时总和不变，为奇数时才减去两倍最小值；漏掉这一步在 [2,-3,-1,5,-4], k=3 上会算错。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}k 没用完要按奇偶处理最小元素；漏掉这一步在 [2,-3,-1,5,-4], k=3 上会错。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{10}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{**}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{18}}
\vsline{4}{0.00em}{}

\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{nonlocal}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}}
\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{left}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{arr}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{15}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\section[分割平衡字符串]{分割平衡字符串（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1221}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}平衡串中 L 与 R 数量相同，把 s 切成尽量多的平衡子串，返回最大段数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "RLRRLLRLRL" $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 计数器归零就切一刀，切了几刀就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素想法：枚举把 s 切成若干段的每一种方案（每个切点切或不切），只保留「每一段都平衡」的方案，取段数最多的。\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在切分方案有 2\textasciicircum{}(n-1) 种，每段还要重新数一遍 L/R，指数级，字符串长一点就 TLE。\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：一次遍历，遇到 L 加一、遇到 R 减一，计数器归零就说明这一段 L 和 R 数量相等，可以立刻切一刀，答案加一。\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n)、空间 O(1)，不用真的构造子串。\par}
\item {\smallfont 细节：越早切越好——切出来的每一段本身都平衡，不会影响后面还能不能继续切；每归零一次就加一，别把最后一段漏掉。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}每归零一次就加一，别把最后一段漏掉；开始前计数器要是 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
