\section[不同路径II]{不同路径II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 63}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}m$\times$n 网格中 1 表示障碍，从左上到右下每次只能向右或向下，求不同路径数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily obstacleGrid = [[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 障碍格直接清零，第一行第一列遇障即断路}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j] 表示从左上角 (0,0) 走到格子 (i,j) 的不同路径数，是一张 m$\times$n 的二维表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化第一列：从 (0,0) 往下走，遇到障碍就 break，后面的格子保持 0；第一行同理从 (0,0) 往右走，遇障即断。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：格子无障碍时 dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]（从上方来 + 从左方来）；格子有障碍时 dp[i][j] = 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 按行从上到下、列从左到右填表，答案在 dp[m-1][n-1]；起点是障碍时 dp[0][0] 保持 0，答案自然为 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成按行滚动的一维 dp[j]（原地 dp[j] += dp[j-1]），见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m·n)，空间 O(m·n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}第一行/第一列遇到障碍要 break 而不是 continue，否则后面的格子会被误填成 1；dp[0][0] 也要先判障碍。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{uniquePathsWithObstacles}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{obstacleGrid}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[不同的二叉搜索树]{不同的二叉搜索树（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 96}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定 n，求用 1\textasciitilde{}n 这些节点能组成的互不相同的二叉搜索树的个数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 3 $\rightarrow$ 5\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 枚举根，左右子树方案数相乘再累加}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i] 表示用 i 个连续节点（1..i）能组成的互不相同的 BST 个数，是一维表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0] = 1，表示空树也是一种方案；少了它整个乘法递推都会变成 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：枚举根节点 j（1..i），左子树 j-1 个节点、右子树 i-j 个节点，dp[i] = Σ dp[j-1] $\times$ dp[i-j]。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 递推到 n，求 dp[i] 时 dp[0..i-1] 都已算好；答案就是 dp[n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont dp[i] 依赖前面所有 dp 值、无法只留常数个状态，空间已是本题最简形态，故没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n\textasciicircum{}2)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}dp[0] 必须初始化为 1（空树算一种），否则所有乘积都是 0；j 从 1 枚举到 i，下标 j-1 会取到 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{numTrees}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i]：i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个连续节点能构成的互不相同的}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{BST}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个数}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{空树算}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{种方案，也是递推的乘法单位元}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{以}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{为根：左子树}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j-1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个节点，右子树}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i-j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个节点}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[不同的子序列]{不同的子序列（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 115}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求字符串 s 的子序列中等于 t 的个数，删除字符不能改变剩余字符顺序。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "rabbbit",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "rabbit" $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 字符相等时用与不用两种选择相加，不等只继承上边}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j] 表示只用 s 的前 i 个字符、凑出 t 的前 j 个字符的子序列方案数，是 (m+1)$\times$(n+1) 的表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[i][0] = 1（凑空串只有一种方案），dp[0][j>0] = 0（空 s 凑不出非空 t）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：s[i-1]==t[j-1] 时 dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + dp[i-1][j]（用当前字符 + 不用当前字符）；不等时 dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j]。\par}
\item {\smallfont i、j 都从 1 开始按行填表，每格只依赖上一行；答案在 dp[m][n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成倒序更新的一维 dp[j]，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(m·n)，空间 O(m·n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}相等时漏掉 dp[i-1][j]（不用当前 s 字符）会少算；dp[i][0] 整列要初始化为 1，一维版 j 必须倒序遍历。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{numDistinct}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：用}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个字符凑出}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{t}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个字符的方案数}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{凑空串只有一种方案：什么都不选}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{用}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{s[i-1]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{不用}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{s[i-1]，两种选择相加}}
\vsline{12}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{15}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{numDistinct}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{t}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[买卖股票的最佳时机III]{买卖股票的最佳时机III（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 123}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定每日股价，最多完成两笔买卖，同一时间只能持一股，求最大利润。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily prices = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 五状态滚动：没交易、一买、一卖、二买、二卖}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[k][0] 表示最多完成 k 次交易且当前不持股的最大利润，dp[k][1] 表示最多完成 k 次交易且当前持股的最大利润，k=0..2 是一张 3$\times$2 的表。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[k][0] = 0（一次都不交易利润为 0），dp[k][1] = -∞（没买过不可能处于持股状态）；k=0 行是哨兵。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：买入 dp[k][1] = max(dp[k][1], dp[k-1][0] - p)，卖出 dp[k][0] = max(dp[k][0], dp[k][1] + p)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 外层按天遍历 prices，内层 k 从 1 到 2，同一天先算买入再算卖出；答案在 dp[2][0]（最多两笔、最终空仓）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成 buy1/sell1/buy2/sell2 四个变量滚动，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}dp[k][1] 初值必须很小（-∞ 或 -prices[0]），设成 0 会把「没买就卖」算成盈利；k=0 行是第一次买入的哨兵，不能省。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxProfit}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[k][0]：最多完成}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{次交易且当前不持股的最大利润}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[k][1]：最多完成}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{次交易且当前持股的最大利润}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsfunc}{float}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"inf"}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{3}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{3}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{第}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{次买入}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{第}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{次卖出}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[分割回文串 II]{分割回文串 II（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 132}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定字符串 s，把它切成若干个回文子串，求最少需要切多少刀。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "aab" $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先判回文表，再拿切点 j 往后接一段回文}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont pal[i][j] 记 s[i..j] 是否回文；dp[i] 是前 i 个字符的最少切割数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=0；pal 由 i 从 n-1 倒推、j 从 i 正推填出。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：pal[0][i-1] 为真则 dp[i]=0，否则 dp[i]=min(dp[j]+1)，j<i 且 pal[j][i-1] 为真。\par}
\item {\smallfont 遍历 i=1..n，答案 dp[n]；pal 表的 i 必须倒序。\par}
\item {\smallfont dp 已是一维、pal 表压不动，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n$^{2}$)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：回文段是 pal[j][i-1]（i 从 1 起），pal 的 i 要倒序推。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minCut}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{pal[i][j]：s[i..j]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{是否回文，i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{要倒着推才能用到内层结果}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pal}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pal}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{pal}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i]：前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个字符的最少切割数，dp[0]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{是空串}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pal}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{16}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{17}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{18}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{pal}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{19}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{20}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[买卖股票的最佳时机IV]{买卖股票的最佳时机IV（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 188}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定价格数组与最多 k 笔交易上限，同一时刻只能持一股，求最大利润。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily k = 2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} prices = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 持股与空仓两组数组，按交易额度 1 到 k 滚动}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[j][0]：至多 j 次交易且空仓的最大现金；dp[j][1]：同额度持股的最大现金。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[j][0]=0、dp[j][1]=-inf，j=0..k。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移（现价 p）：dp[j][0]=max(旧0, 旧1+p)，dp[j][1]=max(旧1, dp[j-1][0]-p)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 外层按天推进、内层 j=1..k，每天用新表承接旧表；答案 max\_j dp[j][0]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一对 hold/free 数组，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(nk)，空间 O(k)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：j 从 1 开始；转移只能读上一行，原地改会同日反复买卖。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{NEG}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ndp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{row}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{row}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{先承接「今天不操作」}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ndp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ndp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[打家劫舍II]{打家劫舍II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 213}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}房屋首尾相接围成一圈，相邻两间不能同偷，求能偷到的最大金额。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 环拆两段：不要首、不要尾，各跑一遍线性版}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 线性段内 dp[i]：该段前 i 间房能偷到的最大金额（下标是间数）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=0（空前缀）、dp[1]=该段第一间的金额。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i]=max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2]+nums[该段第 i 间])。\par}
\item {\smallfont 环拆 [0,n-2] 与 [1,n-1] 各跑一遍，答案取两段 dp[m] 的较大值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成两个滚动变量，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：dp[0]=0 的空前缀要留；两段是 [0,n-2] 与 [1,n-1]，别把首尾一起偷。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{hi}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{lo}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\vsline{11}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{lo}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{lo}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{15}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{line}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{line}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[最佳买卖股票时机含冷冻期]{最佳买卖股票时机含冷冻期（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 309}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}可无限次买卖股票，但卖出后第二天不能买入，求最大利润。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily prices = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 持股、今天卖出、空仓可买，三个状态逐日轮转}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][0] 持股、dp[i][1] 今天卖出（次日冷冻）、dp[i][2] 空仓可买。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0][0]=-prices[0]、dp[0][1]=-inf、dp[0][2]=0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：0=max(昨0, 昨2-p)；1=昨0+p；2=max(昨2, 昨1)。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 到 n-1，只依赖上一行；答案 max(dp[n-1][1], dp[n-1][2])。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成 3 个滚动变量，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：dp[0][1] 必须设 -inf；冷冻期是 2 只接昨 1。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[打家劫舍III]{打家劫舍III（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 337}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}二叉树每个节点存钱，直接相连的父子不能同时偷，求最多能偷多少。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily root = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}null,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 7\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 后序返回两个值：偷本节点、不偷本节点}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 每节点两个状态：dp[node][1] 偷它的最大值，dp[node][0] 不偷它的最大值。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化：空节点返回 (0, 0)。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：偷=node.val+左[0]+右[0]；不偷=max(左[0],左[1])+max(右[0],右[1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont 后序遍历，先拿孩子结果再算自己；答案 max(dp[root][0], dp[root][1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont 每节点只向上返回两个值，没有可压缩的数组，故无空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(h)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}不偷自己时孩子要各自 max 再相加；空节点必须返回 (0,0)。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{l\_take}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l\_skip}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{dfs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{node}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{left}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\section[整数拆分]{整数拆分（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 343}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}把正整数 n 拆成至少两个正整数之和，使这些数的乘积最大。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 10 $\rightarrow$ 36\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 枚举第一刀 j，比两种拆法：只拆两段、继续拆后段}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i]：把 i 拆成至少两个正整数之和能得到的最大乘积。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=dp[1]=0，数组开 n+1。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i]=max(dp[i], j*(i-j), j*dp[i-j])，j=1..i//2。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 2 到 n 递增，j 到 i//2 即对称够用；答案 dp[n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 一维 dp 已是最简形态，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：dp[0]、dp[1] 无解取 0，循环从 i=2 起；两种拆法都要比。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{integerBreak}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i]：把}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{拆成至少两段能得到的最大乘积}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{//}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[组合总和IV]{组合总和IV（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 377}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给定无重复正整数数组，求凑成目标值的排列个数，顺序不同算不同。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 4 $\rightarrow$ 7\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 外层容量内层物品，数出来的是排列数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[j]：凑出金额 j 的排列数，[1,2] 与 [2,1] 算两种。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=1：凑 0 只有「什么都不选」一种。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[j]=Σ dp[j-x]（对所有 x$\leq$j）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 外层金额递增、内层枚举 nums 才数出排列；答案 dp[target]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 一维已是最简形态，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(target·n)，空间 O(target)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：先物品后金额会变成组合数；dp[0]=1 漏了全表全 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{combinationSum4}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[j]：凑出金额}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的排列数（顺序不同算不同）}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[判断子序列]{判断子序列（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 392}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}判断字符串 s 是否为 t 的子序列，即删掉 t 中若干字符后能否得到 s。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "abc",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} t = "ahbgdc" $\rightarrow$ true\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 一根指针盯着 s，扫 t 对上就往前走}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont DP 视角：f[i][j] 表示 s 前 i 个是否为 t 前 j 个的子序列。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 f[0][j]=True（空串），f[i][0]=False（i>0）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：f[i][j]=f[i][j-1] 或 (s[i-1]==t[j-1] 且 f[i-1][j-1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont i、j 递增，答案 f[n][m]；双指针等价于把这张表压成一个变量。\par}
\item {\smallfont 双指针已是 O(1) 空间的最简形态，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+m)，空间 O(1)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}s 为空要返回 true；字符不等时只推进 t 的指针，别动 i。\par}

\section[一和零]{一和零（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 474}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}从 01 字符串数组中选尽量多的串，使 0 的总数$\leq$m 且 1 的总数$\leq$n。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily strs = ["10",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"0001",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"111001",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"1",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"0"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} m = 5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} n = 3 $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 二维 01 背包，0 和 1 各占一维容量}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：至多 i 个 0、j 个 1 能装下的最多字符串个数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 整表初始化为 0：容量为 0 时一个也装不下。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i][j]=max(dp[i][j], dp[i-z][j-o]+1)，z/o 是当前串的 0、1 个数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 外层串、两维容量都倒序，答案 dp[m][n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 二维容量就是主版本，压不动，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(L·m·n)，空间 O(m·n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：两维都要倒序，正序会重复用同一个串。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findMaxForm}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：至多}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{0、j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{能装下的最多串数}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{strs}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{zeros}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{count}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsstr}{"0"}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ones}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{zeros}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{zeros}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ones}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{zeros}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ones}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[目标和]{目标和（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 494}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给每个数前添 + 或 -，求使最终表达式的和等于 target 的添法数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} target = 3 $\rightarrow$ 5\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 正号集的和固定，转成 01 背包数方案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：前 i 个数凑出和 (j-off) 的方案数，off=sum(nums) 用来平移负下标。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0][off]=1（一个数不用、和为 0），其余为 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-x]+dp[i-1][j+x]，x=nums[i-1]。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 到 n、j 扫全表；答案 dp[n][target+off]，|target|>sum 先返回 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可压成一维滚动；还能转成 0/1 背包一维倒序，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·S)，空间 O(n·S)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：dp[0][off] 才是「和为 0」的起点；每行只能从上一行取。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findTargetSumWays}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{abs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{target}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{off}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{和的范围}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{[-total,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{total]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{统一右移，避免负下标}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{W}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{total}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：用前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个数凑出和}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{(j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{off)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的方案数}}
\vsline{9}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{W}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{off}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{W}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{14}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{16}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{W}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[斐波那契数]{斐波那契数（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 509}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求第 n 个斐波那契数，F(0)=0、F(1)=1、F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2)。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily n = 4 $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 两个变量滚动：a, b = b, a+b，跑 n 轮}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i] 表示第 i 个斐波那契数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=0、dp[1]=1；n=0 先特判返回 0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i]=dp[i-1]+dp[i-2]。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 2 到 n 递增，答案 dp[n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成两个滚动变量，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：n=0 时 dp[1] 越界，要先特判；循环从 i=2 起。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{fib}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{4}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i]：第}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个斐波那契数}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}}
