\section[最长回文子序列]{最长回文子序列（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 516}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求字符串中最长回文子序列的长度，子序列不要求连续。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "bbbab" $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 区间 DP：首尾相同就加 2，不同就掐掉一头}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：s[i..j] 的最长回文子序列长度（区间 DP，可不连续）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[i][i]=1，其余为 0（i>j 的空区间算 0）。\par}
\item {\smallfont s[i]==s[j] 时 dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j-1]+2，否则 max(dp[i+1][j], dp[i][j-1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 n-1 倒推、j 从 i+1 正推，答案 dp[0][n-1]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一行倒序滚动，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n$^{2}$)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：i 必须倒序推；长度 1 的格子要先填 1，否则会读到 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{longestPalindromeSubseq}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：s[i..j]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的最长回文子序列长度（区间}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{DP）}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 优化解法（提交用）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{longestPalindromeSubseq}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{更新前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[j]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{就是}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i+1][j]}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[零钱兑换II]{零钱兑换II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 518}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每种硬币可用无限枚，求凑出总金额 amount 的组合数，顺序不计。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily amount = 5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} coins = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 4\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 外层物品内层容量正序，数出来的是组合数}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：只用前 i 种硬币凑出金额 j 的组合数（顺序不计）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[i][0]=1（凑 0 元只有空组合），dp[0][j]=0。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j]+dp[i][j-c]，后者表示再用一枚第 i 种。\par}
\item {\smallfont 外层物品、内层金额正序（同一行才能继续拿这枚）；答案 dp[k][amount]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一维正序滚动，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(k·amount)，空间 O(k·amount)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：必须引 dp[i][j-c] 才能无限用；内外层反了变排列数。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{change}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{amount}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{coins}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{coins}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：用前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{种硬币凑出金额}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{的组合数}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{amount}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{1.20em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{凑}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{0}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{元：一枚都不选}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{coins}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{amount}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{12}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{14}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{amount}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{coins}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[两个字符串的删除操作]{两个字符串的删除操作（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 583}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每步可删除任一字符串中的一个字符，求让两个字符串相同的最少步数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily word1 = "sea",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} word2 = "eat" $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先求最长公共子序列，答案 = 两长之和 - 2$\times$LCS}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：word1 前 i 个与 word2 前 j 个的最长公共子序列长度。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化第 0 行、第 0 列都为 0（任一串为空时 LCS 为 0）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 相等 dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1，否则 max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont i、j 都从 1 递增；答案 n+m-2*dp[n][m]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一行滚动 + prev，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(nm)，空间 O(nm)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：比较 word1[i-1] 与 word2[j-1]；答案里的 2$\times$ 别漏。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minDistance}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{word1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{word2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{word1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{word2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：word1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个与}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{word2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{前}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{个的}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{LCS}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{长度}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{word1}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{word2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{else}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[回文子串]{回文子串（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 647}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}统计字符串中回文子串的个数，起止位置不同即算不同的子串。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily s = "aaa" $\rightarrow$ 6\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 区间 dp 打回文标记，标一个计数加一}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：s[i..j] 是否回文，按布尔区间表计数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 整表初始化为 False（空区间和未算的格子都不是回文）。\par}
\item {\smallfont s[i]==s[j] 且 (j-i<=2 或 dp[i+1][j-1]) 时置真并让答案加一。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 n-1 倒推、j 从 i 正推；答案就是计数总和。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成中心扩展（O(1) 空间），见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n$^{2}$)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：j-i<=2 的短路不能漏，否则会读无意义的 dp[i+1][j-1]。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{countSubstrings}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{str}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：s[i..j]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{是否回文}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{s}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{and}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{or}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{ans}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{ans}}
\end{vscode}

\section[最长递增子序列的个数]{最长递增子序列的个数（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 673}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求数组中最长严格递增子序列的个数，长度并列的不同序列都计数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 长度与个数两个数组：更长就覆盖，等长就累加}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont length[i]：以 nums[i] 结尾的 LIS 长度；cnt[i]：达到该长度的条数。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 length、cnt 全为 1（每个数自己是一条长度 1 的序列）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 更长则覆盖 length[i]、cnt[i]=cnt[j]；等长则 cnt[i]+=cnt[j]。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 递增、j<i，边算边记 best；答案把所有 length==best 的 cnt 求和。\par}
\item {\smallfont 两个一维数组已最简，没有空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n$^{2}$)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：更长覆盖、等长累加别写反；最后按 best 求和，不能返回 cnt[n-1]。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findNumberOfLIS}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{length[i]：以}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{结尾的}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{LIS}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{长度；cnt[i]：达到该长度的条数}}

\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{<}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{>}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{13}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{14}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{elif}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{15}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{16}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{sum}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{zip}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{length}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cnt}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{l}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\end{vscode}

\section[最长连续递增序列]{最长连续递增序列（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 674}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求数组中最长且下标连续递增的序列长度。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 比前一个大就加一，否则归 1，顺手记最大}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i]：以 nums[i] 结尾的最长连续递增子序列长度。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[i]=1，每个元素自己就是长度 1 的段。\par}
\item {\smallfont nums[i]>nums[i-1] 时 dp[i]=dp[i-1]+1，否则 dp[i]=1。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 到 n-1；答案是 max(dp)，不是 dp[n-1]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一个变量 + best，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：答案取全表 max；空数组先返回 0；相等不算递增，要断开。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[买卖股票的最佳时机含手续费]{买卖股票的最佳时机含手续费（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 714}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}可无限次买卖股票，每笔交易需付一次手续费 fee，求最大利润。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily prices = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}9]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} fee = 2 $\rightarrow$ 8\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 持股与空仓两个状态，卖出时扣一次 fee}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][0]：第 i 天空仓的最大利润；dp[i][1]：第 i 天持股的最大现金。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0][0]=0、dp[0][1]=-prices[0]（第 0 天买入）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：0=max(昨0, 昨1+p-fee)；1=max(昨1, 昨0-p)。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 到 n-1，只依赖上一行；答案是 dp[n-1][0]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成两个滚动变量，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：fee 只在卖出侧扣一次；dp[0][1] 别初始化成 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{maxProfit}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{fee}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][0]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{空仓的最大利润，dp[i][1]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{持股的最大现金}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{prices}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{9}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{fee}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{10}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{p}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\section[最长重复子数组]{最长重复子数组（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 718}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}求两个整数数组中最长的公共连续子数组长度。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2 = [3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 3\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai dp 定义为以 i-1、j-1 结尾，对不上就归零}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：以 nums1[i-1]、nums2[j-1] 结尾的最长公共连续子数组长度。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化第 0 行、第 0 列为 0 当哨兵，省掉越界判断。\par}
\item {\smallfont 相等 dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1，不等必须置 0（连续断了）。\par}
\item {\smallfont i、j 从 1 递增；答案边算边取 max，不是 dp[n][m]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一行滚动 + prev，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(nm)，空间 O(nm)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：不等要清零而不是取 max；答案是全表最大值。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findLength}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i][j]：以}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{nums1[i-1]、nums2[j-1]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{结尾的公共连续段长度}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{8}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{9}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums1}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nums2}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}
\vsline{11}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{max}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{best}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{j}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{12}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{best}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{11}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{x}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{data}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{12}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{m}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{13}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vstext}{best}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{14}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[使用最小花费爬楼梯]{使用最小花费爬楼梯（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 746}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每级台阶有体力花费，每次可跨 1 或 2 级，求到达楼顶的最小花费。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily cost = [10,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}15,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}20]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 15\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai dp[i]=min(前两级)+cost[i]，末两步取小}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i]：到达第 i 级台阶的最小花费，dp[0]=dp[1]=0 表示从地面起步。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化 dp[0]=dp[1]=0，其余留空。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：dp[i]=min(dp[i-1]+cost[i-1], dp[i-2]+cost[i-2])。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 2 到 n；楼顶在最后一级之后，答案是 dp[n]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成两个滚动变量，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：dp 要开 n+1（楼顶是 dp[n]）；dp[0]、dp[1] 都是 0。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{minCostClimbingStairs}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vscmt}{\#}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{dp[i]：到达第}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{级台阶的最小花费，dp[n]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vscmt}{就是到楼顶}}
\vsline{5}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{6}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{7}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{2}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{8}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{dp}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\end{vscode}

\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{prev}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cost}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{prev}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{min}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{prev}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{cur}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{c}}

\end{vscode}

\section[不相交的线]{不相交的线（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1035}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}两行数字之间连等值直线，要求互不相交，求最多能连多少条。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily nums1 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} nums2 = [1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 2\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 线不相交就是相对顺序一致，等价于最长公共子序列}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：前 i 个与前 j 个能连出的最多不相交线条数，等价于 LCS 长度。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化第 0 行、第 0 列为 0（任一数组为空就连不了线）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 相等 dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1，否则 max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])。\par}
\item {\smallfont i、j 从 1 递增；答案是 dp[n][m]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一行滚动 + prev，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(nm)，空间 O(nm)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：不等时取 max 而不是清零（清零是 718 子数组的写法）。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}

\section[最后一块石头的重量II]{最后一块石头的重量II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 1049}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}每回合取两块石头相撞粉碎，求最后剩下那块石头的最小可能重量。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily stones = [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}8,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 1\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 尽量把石头分成两堆接近的，答案就是两堆之差}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont dp[i][j]：前 i 块石头、容量 j 的 0/1 背包能装出的最大重量。\par}
\item {\smallfont 初始化第 0 行全 0（没有石头可装）。\par}
\item {\smallfont 转移：max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i-1][j-w]+w)，w=stones[i-1] 且 j>=w。\par}
\item {\smallfont i 从 1 到 n、j 从 0 到 half；答案 total-2*dp[n][half]。\par}
\item {\smallfont 空间可优化成一维倒序滚动，见空间优化版。\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·sum)，空间 O(n·sum)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}表 DP 坑：j<w 时要继承上一行；一维压缩必须倒序，正序就成完全背包。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vspace{2pt}
\section[单词接龙]{单词接龙（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 127}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}给 beginWord、endWord 与字典，每次只改一个字母且中间词须在字典中，求最短转换序列的单词数。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily beginWord = "hit",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} endWord = "cog",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} wordList = ["hot",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"dot",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"dog",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"lot",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"log",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"cog"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 5\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 逐位换 26 个字母做 BFS，一碰到终点就是最短路}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从 beginWord 出发做 BFS，但每出队一个词就把整个字典扫一遍，逐字符数差异找邻居\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个词都要和全部 N 个词比一遍，O(N$^{2}$·L)，字典一大就 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：字典换成 set，把「找邻居」改成逐位枚举 26 个字母直接造词，O(L·26) 查一次\par}
\item {\smallfont 再用距离表去重，第一次碰到 endWord 就是最短转换序列\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(N·L·26)，空间 O(N·L)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(N·L·26)，空间 O(N·L)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}先判 endWord 是否在字典；访问标记用字典，别每次线性扫列表。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}

\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{used}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{words}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}

\vsline{16}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{word}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{17}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{18}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vstext}{diff}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{0}}
\vsline{19}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{zip}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{word}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{nxt}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{20}{12.04em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{a}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{!=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{b}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{21}{14.45em}{\textcolor{vstext}{diff}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}}

\section[被围绕的区域]{被围绕的区域（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 130}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}m$\times$n 的 X/O 矩阵，把所有被 X 完全包围的 O 区域改成 X，边界上的 O 及与其连通的不动。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily board = [["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"O",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"O",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"O",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"O",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}["X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"O",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X",\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}"X"]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 从边界上的 O 反着灌，灌不到的 O 才填 X}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：对每个 O 格子单独泛洪一整块，看这一块有没有摸到边界\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个格子都要把整块重搜一遍，O((mn)$^{2}$)，矩阵一大就 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 慢在重复搜同一块；优化是反过来从边界上的 O 往里灌，能灌到的就是安全区\par}
\item {\smallfont 灌不到的 O 才是被包围的，最后统一改成 X\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}四条边界都要遍历（含四个角）；改标记和入栈必须同时做，否则重复入栈。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[课程表II]{课程表II（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 210}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}n 门课与先修关系，返回能学完所有课程的顺序，存在环时返回空。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily numCourses = 4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} prerequisites = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 入度为 0 先入队，出队就削后继入度，凑不够数就是有环}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：每轮从头扫一遍所有课，挑一个入度为 0 的修掉，再把它后继的入度减一\par}
\item {\smallfont 每修一门都要 O(n) 扫描，总共 O(n$^{2}$)，课程一多就 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：把入度为 0 的课先装进队列，出队时只处理它的后继\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个点和每条边都只碰一次，最后答案长度不足 n 就说明有环\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n+e)，空间 O(n+e)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n+e)，空间 O(n+e)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}prerequisites[i] = [后修, 先修]，边方向是先修$\rightarrow$后修，别建反。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[太平洋大西洋水流问题]{太平洋大西洋水流问题（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 417}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}m$\times$n 高度矩阵，水只流向高度不增的相邻格，求既能到左上两洋又能到右下两洋的格子。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily heights = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[6,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}7,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}5]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[5,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}4]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[3,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[4,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 别正向找海，从两片海往高处倒灌，两张表取交集}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：对每个格子分别向太平洋、大西洋各搜一次，看水能不能流到那边\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个格子两次整图搜索，O((mn)$^{2}$)，矩阵一大就 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：倒过来想，从两片海的边界往高处灌，只走高度不低于当前格的格子\par}
\item {\smallfont 分别得到太平洋、大西洋的可达表，两张表都真的坐标就是答案\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(mn)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}倒灌条件是下一格高度 $\geq$ 当前格，写反就变成顺流而下。\par}
\vspace{13pt}

\section[岛屿的周长]{岛屿的周长（简单）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 463}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}row$\times$col 的 0/1 网格中恰好有一个岛屿，求它的周长。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily grid = [[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}0]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ 16\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 每块陆地先算四条边，邻居是陆地就减一}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：逐格遍历，每个 1 先算 4 条边，再看上下左右，越界或是 0 就记一条边界\par}
\item {\smallfont 每个格子只查四个方向，O(mn)，已经是最直接的写法\par}
\item {\smallfont 这题不需要 DFS/BFS，也没有更快的渐近做法，保持一遍扫描即可\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(mn)，空间 O(1)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(mn)，空间 O(1)\par}

\section[冗余连接]{冗余连接（中等）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 684}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}n 个点的树被多加了一条无向边，按数组顺序求删掉后能恢复树的那条边，多解取最后。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily edges = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 按顺序并查集，第一次发现两端已同根的就是答案}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从后往前依次删掉一条边，再 BFS 看剩下的 n 个点是否还连通\par}
\item {\smallfont 每条候选边都要重建图并搜一遍，O(n$^{2}$)，边数大时会 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：按输入顺序做并查集，第一次遇到两端已同根就说明这条边闭合了环\par}
\item {\smallfont 从前往后合并，这条成环边天然就是「多解取最后」的那条\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n·$\alpha$(n))，空间 O(n)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·$\alpha$(n))，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}节点编号 1\textasciitilde{}n，父亲数组开 n+1；先判同根再合并。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
\begin{vscode}{solution.py}{Python}
\vsline{1}{0.00em}{\textcolor{vskw}{class}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsclass}{Solution}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{2}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{findRedundantConnection}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{:}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{->}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{List}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsfunc}{int}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{3}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{len}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{4}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{-}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{5}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsfunc}{connected}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{6}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{k}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{7}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{return}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{8}{0.00em}{}
\vsline{9}{2.41em}{\textcolor{vskw}{def}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{connected}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vskw}{self}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{skip}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{10}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{graph}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{\_}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{range}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}
\vsline{11}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{for}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{u}\textcolor{vstext}{,}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsctrl}{in}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsfunc}{enumerate}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{edges}\textcolor{vstext}{)}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{12}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{if}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{i}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{==}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{skip}\textcolor{vstext}{:}}
\vsline{13}{9.63em}{\textcolor{vsctrl}{continue}}
\vsline{14}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{graph}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{u}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{15}{7.22em}{\textcolor{vstext}{graph}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vstext}{v}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\textcolor{vstext}{.}\textcolor{vsvar}{append}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{u}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{16}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vskw}{False}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{*}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{(}\textcolor{vstext}{n}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{+}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{)}}
\vsline{17}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{seen}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vskw}{True}}
\vsline{18}{4.82em}{\textcolor{vstext}{stack}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{=}\hspace*{0.60em}\allowbreak{}\textcolor{vstext}{[}\textcolor{vsnum}{1}\textcolor{vstext}{]}}

\section[冗余连接II]{冗余连接II（困难）\hfill{\normalfont\fontsize{9.5}{12}\selectfont\color{grayt}LeetCode 685}}
\indent{\bodyfont \lab{题意}有向图由一棵有根树加一条边构成，求删掉后能恢复有根树的那条边，多解取最后出现。\par}
\vspace{5pt}
\noindent{\lab{示例}\begingroup\raggedright\fontsize{9.6}{13}\selectfont\ttfamily edges = [[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}2]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[1,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}[2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{} $\rightarrow$ [2,\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}3]\allowbreak{}\allowbreak{}\par\endgroup}
\vspace{9pt}
\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{记忆}\quad{\kai 先找入度为 2 的点试删两条边，没有就并查集找有向环}\par}
\vspace{11pt}
\noindent{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont 思路}\par\vspace{3pt}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=2.0em,itemsep=4pt,topsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,label={\fontsize{10.5}{13}\selectfont\arabic*.}]
\item {\smallfont 朴素：从后往前依次删掉一条边，再检查剩下的图是不是一棵有根树\par}
\item {\smallfont 每试删一次都要重建入度和邻接表再搜一遍，O(n$^{2}$)，边数大时会 TLE\par}
\item {\smallfont 优化：先找入度为 2 的点，它只有两条候选边，从后往前试删即可\par}
\item {\smallfont 验环用并查集；没有入度为 2 的点，就直接按顺序并查集找有向环\par}
\item {\smallfont 时间 O(n·$\alpha$(n))，空间 O(n)\par}
\end{enumerate}
\vspace{6pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{复杂度}时间 O(n·$\alpha$(n))，空间 O(n)\par}
\vspace{4pt}\noindent{\bodyfont \lab{易错}候选边要从后往前试；每试删一次都要重建并查集。\par}
\vspace{13pt}
\noindent{\smallfont\sffamily\bfseries 朴素解法（先看这个）}\par\vspace{-5pt}
